news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions

news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 3 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 24 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 27 why bobby picked the bills fool me once shame on you fool me twice shame on me i will not be picking the chargers for a third straight week nor am i likely to throw my support behind them very much at all in the coming months considering the juggernauts lined up to face them first up on that list the bills who look to be the cream of the afc crop in the early goings of this season josh allen is on fire having already accounted for nine touchdowns five passing four rushing while leading buffalo to 36 or more points in each of the team s first two games while there are some pressing questions about the bills defense nothing has come easy to the chargers in mike mcdaniel s new scheme justin herbert looks uncomfortable his pass catchers have been affected by multiple big drops and injuries and lead back omarion hampton has lost a fumble in both games there s nothing to suggest los angeles can string together enough scoring drives to keep up with buffalo s mighty offense look for the bills to move to 3 0 in dominating fashion why bobby picked the panthers cleveland s upset victory over the buccaneers felt more like tampa bay continuing to be the team that fell on its face throughout the end of last season than a sign the browns will stick it to another nfc south opponent lest that be misconstrued as a browns is the browns take cleveland played well and fought hard for its win deshaun watson was as precise as he s been in years rookie denzel boston looks like a stud and the browns defense was the far more composed side during the game s final two minutes in the aftermath of a 132 minute weather delay the panthers just happen to be playing better ball than both the bucs and the browns bryce young is off to the best start of his career buoyed by the budding wide receiver duo of tetairoa mcmillan and jalen coker he s averaged 324 passing yards through two games with three touchdown passes in each contest it s not out of the question he keeps it going against a cleveland defense still navigating the early days of the post myles garrett era the wild card remains the panthers defensive jekyll and hyde act to start the season are they the closer to the group that gave up 59 points to an explosive bears team in the opener or the unit that dominated a woeful falcons squad while allowing just 3 points even if it s more the former dave canales offense should be able to do enough for a victory why jeremy picked the lions aaron glenn s return to detroit where he was dan campbell s defensive coordinator for four seasons will be the ultimate test for his jets defense s early turnaround after games against the titans and packers offenses asterisk needed gang green s defense which received an influx of veteran talent in the offseason ranks in the top three in yards per game 197 0 first yards per play 4 0 third and third down conversion rate 23 8 second new york will be without a few injured vets in the motor city but should get back joseph ossai for sunday s game whether glenn s jets feast depends on which lions team shows up detroit has a talent advantage on offense but has yet to play a complete game this season nearly blowing week 1 against new orleans forgetting to show up until the second half of the bills loss the lions defense is banged up but so is new york s receiving corps detroit s best bet sunday is getting to geno smith with aidan hutchinson and co the qb hasn t turned the ball over yet but he s faced a 43 4 pressure rate second in the nfl only to the injured jayden daniels and the veteran is due despite his claims otherwise as week 2 proved the jets still need to learn how to win new york is close but the lesson won t come this week against a tested lions team why gennaro picked the texans is this an elimination game in september as the only week 3 matchup between winless teams this afc south showdown screams desperation since 1990 just 2 9 percent of squads that lost their first three games went on to make the playoffs we re talkin five out of 171 people of course last year s texans were one of those five and while houston s hyped defense looked shockingly porous against josh allen s bills in week 1 the unit largely stifled joe burrow and the bengals last sunday i anticipate continued success against a one dimensional colts offense jonathan taylor s a stud no doubt but he has to be a one man army with daniel jones still seemingly working his way back from last december s achilles tear add in the fact that indianapolis 114 million field stretcher just hit injured reserve and houston can commit additional resources to stopping the colts bell cow back meanwhile indy s defense hasn t been able to stop anyone giving up the second most yards ever in the first two weeks of a season 1 2016 raiders 1 035 yards allowed 2 2026 colts 1 029 t 3 1967 falcons 1 025 t 3 2017 saints 1 025 oddly enough the two bookends on that list the 2016 raiders and 2017 saints both made the playoffs with double digit wins maybe the colts have everyone right where they want them or maybe they re doomed to suffer a sixth straight loss to c j stroud and co why dan picked the jaguars there will be no sneaking up on anyone for this season s jaguars and patriots not after they both surprised in 2025 sunday s meeting is an opportunity to establish which squad has more staying power in the afc s upper ranks and the trenches might dictate which team has the edge jacksonville needs better play from the offensive line especially on the interior if it s going to bounce back from blowing a lead against denver new england has a duo that can exploit a team s weakness up the middle with milton williams and christian barmore at defensive tackle one thing that could work in the jags favor is the pats ailing health new england has taken hits to the league s no 1 scoring defense edge rusher dre mont jones and safety craig woodson missed wednesday s practice with shoulder issues and lost rg mike onwenu ankle to injured reserve i m leaning ever so slightly toward the home team in what figures to be a highly entertaining battle why gennaro picked the chiefs two weeks ago we didn t really know what to expect from kansas city the chiefs were coming off their first losing campaign under andy reid while patrick mahomes was returning from knee surgery two games into the season it feels like the team and the quarterback are back whole different story in miami we all knew the 2026 dolphins would be bad that s what happens when a new regime takes the roster down to the studs and carries a whopping 183 7 million in dead money but this feels like a dead team walking what does miami do well without any established firepower beyond rb de von achane the offense can t sustain drives the defense had no answer for raiders rb ashton jeanty in week 1 and nearly allowed a perfect game from 49ers qb brock purdy in week 2 so the better question might be what does miami do this is a rebuilding team without an identity that doesn t play well against a resurgent power with hall of fame leadership yes this is miami s home opener and kansas city s first road game no i don t think that completely flips the script in the fins favor why gennaro picked the titans both teams are coming off a loss but their vibes couldn t be more different tennessee gave philadelphia all it could handle in a 24 20 defeat instilling confidence in the young titans that they can compete with real super bowl contenders a true moral victory new york on the other hand suffered extreme agony in defeat the giants not only lost to the rams by 22 points but they lost jaxson dart to knee surgery john harbaugh had a thousand yard stare after the second year quarterback went down on monday night and now he has to steer the ship without his best defensive player too as brian burns is reportedly set to miss time with an ankle injury remember all that hope following new york s season opening win over dallas consider it dashed the g men just experienced a devastating gut punch and i think the effects carry over into sunday s game against a suddenly frisky foe you know tennessee oc brian daboll would love to knock off the team that fired him last november and while head coach robert saleh failed to exact his revenge on the jets in week 1 he d undoubtedly enjoy notching his first win as titans head coach in his old home of metlife stadium why brooke picked the bengals cincinnati is seeing the fruits of its offseason labor defensively and perhaps no player has been more influential to his new team than dt dexter lawrence through two weeks according to ngs with lawrence on the field the defense has generated a 45 2 pressure rate allowed 2 9 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 58 3 of carries without him on the field cincy has generated a 35 1 pressure rate allowed 5 6 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 21 4 of carries sexy dexy s influence bodes well for a bengals team heading into a hostile road environment to face an offense in which the qb and play caller don t appear to be on the same page even if pittsburgh gets michael pittman foot back this unit doesn t strike fear in anyone right now and isn t likely to keep up with joe burrow ja 39 marr chase and the bengals oh so explosive offense there s a lot of pressure on the steelers eighth ranked overall and scoring defense to make plays it ll make its fair share but ultimately it won t be enough one nfl pro insight matchup to watch bengals lt orlando brown vs steelers olb alex highsmith brown has allowed a pressure on 13 of his pass blocks against the steelers in 13 career games including the postseason the highest rate he has allowed against any opponent min 100 pass blocks that rate jumps to 15 1 if you limit it to browns time with the bengals six games against pittsburgh meanwhile highsmith has generated 24 pressures against brown including 16 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds the fourth most quick pressures by any pass rusher against a single blocker since 2018 nick herbig has added 13 pressures and three sacks on 78 matchups against brown why dan picked the seahawks just when it seemed like the commanders were starting to cook on offense they are forced once again to face life without jayden daniels who has now had more dislocations of his left elbow than any person should ever have to experience unfortunately for backup qb marcus mariota his return to a starting role coincides with a visit from arguably the league s most ferocious defense the 2026 seahawks are one of just five defenses since 2010 to allow fewer than 20 points and fewer than four yards per play over their first two games of a season per nfl research each of the previous four teams to do so won 11 or more games it s true that seattle might be trotting out its own backup qb for the second week in a row but drew lock has proven a tremendous fill in for sam darnold editor s update on friday seahawks coach mike macdonald announced that sam darnold is returning to the starting lineup on sunday there s always the threat of a west coast team being discombobulated by a cross country trip but i m not paying it any mind in this case the seahawks are 7 0 in road games that kicked off at 1 p m et under head coach mike macdonald why jeremy picked the 49ers no team is having an easier start to the season than san francisco blowout victories over the jet lagged rams and doe eyed dolphins have the 49ers playing out of this world even when they re on the other side of it in come the cardinals who after a week 1 upset over the potentially fraudulent chargers were who we thought they were against the cream of the nfc west crop in the seahawks the 49ers pose a similar problem to arizona as the hawks did and with brock purdy in the zone the result should be similar expect san francisco to control sunday s game from the jump but just miss out on winning their straight game by at least 20 points thanks to garbage time heroics by trey mcbride and michael wilson why brooke picked the vikings there s early concern around zac robinson s offense in tampa my colleague nick shook s assessment of baker mayfield under his nth oc said it all the veteran qb is uncomfortable in this scheme at this juncture having to right the ship against a blitz happy vikings defense feels like an uphill climb despite mayfield performing well in such situations of late when blitzed this season he has a 68 8 success rate the second highest among qualified qbs per ngs that s a big jump up from his 39 3 mark in 2025 the third lowest if baker can navigate brian flores ferocious front deciphering when the no nonsense dc is sending the house or dropping guys into coverage the bucs should stay competitive i would have argued that tampa has the upper hand if carson wentz were starting but praise jesus we don t have to watch that stuck in the mud quarterback this week with kyler murray set to return we should finally get a better idea of what kevin o connell s offense looks like at close to full strength that ll be especially true if todd bowles defense continues to underperform cleveland s deshaun watson had his best outing in years against the bucs last week and to make matters worse first round edge rusherrueben bain s status is uncertain these teams are trending in opposite directions heading into this nfc clash why bobby picked the saints raiders saints might be the most underrated matchup on the week 3 docket new orleans an overtime two point conversion away from being 2 0 hosts a las vegas squad that remains unbeaten heading into late september the raiders have been playing winning football and doing so without tight end brock bowers who is expected to return from a knee injury sunday but it does come off as more of a mirage than what the saints have been doing while kirk cousins is tied for the nfl lead with six touchdown passes and the defense ranks fifth in points allowed with a league best 45 6 pressure percentage per pro football reference such success has so far come against the rebuilding dolphins and a chargers team in a tailspin even with the loss against the lions new orleans boasts the more impressive resume following its comeback victory over the ravens tyler shough has exhibited an excellent rapport with his top three pass catchers chris olave devaughn vele and juwan johnson he also appears to have the clutch gene after storming back from 21 down to force detroit to overtime and overcoming an 8 point fourth quarter deficit in the win over baltimore if the saints can keep shough comfortable against maxx crosby and co admittedly a big if with left tackle kelvin banks ankle out indefinitely the second year quarterback can be trusted to deliver again in new orleans 2026 home opener why jeremy picked the cowboys how do you say points in portuguese two of the league s most exciting offenses have the potential to produce a classico at the maracana on sunday in only its second international game dallas is looking to export its week 2 bounce back performance over the equator with possession dak prescott s attack proved what it s capable of against washington after their snf snoozer lamar jackson derrick henry and friends will hope to play keep away from dallas as the giants did in week 1 but if zay flowers hamstring misses a second straight game baltimore s aerial attack could be neutered again against a cowboys defense that hasn t found its footing yet under new coordinator christian parker as long as both teams actually have proper footing on the brazilian turf they should tear up and down the field but it ll be dak and dallas with more points in the end if the ravens had trouble with chris olave down the stretch in week 2 just think of the problems they ll encounter covering two olaves in ceedee lamb and george pickens in week 3 why gennaro picked the rams the super bowl lx matchup that wasn t eight months ago the rams and broncos suffered narrow defeats on championship sunday leaving both painfully short of the lombardi trophy game then they opened this season by hitting the road and humiliating themselves on national television both returned to form at home in week 2 though setting up a compelling clash worthy of the sunday night stage showcasing a pair of super bowl winning head coaches and two of the league s most well rounded rosters this game doesn t lack for star power and yet i see its outcome hinging on the rams meat and potatoes kyren williams and blake corum with eerily similar frames games and jersey numbers 23 and 24 l a s two backs are difficult to tell apart and so is their robust ground production through two games williams 23 rushes for 126 yards 5 5 per attempt and a touchdown corum 22 rushes for 133 yards 6 0 per attempt i see los angeles blue collar backfield playing a leading role in this prime time tilt denver cleaned up its tackling last week after an embarrassing display against kansas city s kenneth walker but i still think this front s susceptible to the run free agent departure john franklin myers got 63 million for a reason monday sept 28 why dan picked the eagles questions about the bears quarterback situation linger over what had previously looked like a juicy matchup bathed in prime time allure caleb williams is dealing with the hamstring injury he suffered last week and his backup tyson bagent is in the concussion protocol which means 38 year old third stringer case keenum is in line to start for chicago on monday night if williams and bagent can t go keenum hasn t played in a regular season game since 2023 when he threw one touchdown pass and three interceptions in two starts for the texans it s not hard to envision philadelphia defensive coordinator vic fangio rubbing his hands together in glee at his good fortune potentially missing out on having to game plan against one of the league s most dynamic young qbs and his capable backup the eagles have the lowest point differential 6 of any 2 0 team and struggled to put away the titans who haven t been competitive in years so while they might not be firing on all cylinders it will take an even larger letdown than the team s performance on black friday last year when the bears ran wild over philly to open the door for keenum to pull off the upset it looks like we re about to find out if ben johnson can perform miracles thursday s game why brooke picked the packers the packers lucky to eke out a victory in new york to avoid falling to 0 2 finally return to beloved lambeau field where they have won each of their last 13 home openers i have concerns about jordan love s o line which just lost starting right tackle zach bako bewele for the season and has others banged up og aaron banks ot anthony belton and backup ol donovan jennings love has already taken seven sacks tied for third most faced the fifth highest pressure rate in the nfl this season 42 3 and is tied for the most unblocked pressures faced 12 per nfl pro how matt lafleur game plans for his shorthanded offense against a falcons defense that ranks first against the run ninth on third down and in the red zone and has generated pressure on 41 5 percent on dropbacks seventh in the nfl per next gen stats could tell part of thursday night s story not having cb a j terrell hurts atlanta s chances of slowing christian watson and matthew golden but having michael penix under center should be a boon for that team even if he s still knocking off the rust this should look like a more competent unit one that s better suited to get bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts more involved these are two flawed teams and though i think we ll see an improved falcons outfit green bay has a much needed home field edge and a defense that s playing with confidence with budding star lukas van ness at the forefront clean up the penalties and this could be a turning point for the pack visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Stories of the Dan Campbell-Aaron Glenn friendship, three decades in the making
news_mentions.body_text: on a thursday morning like this one dan campbell and aaron glenn would typically be here tucked away in glenn 39 s office they 39 d put the finishing touches on the game plan and discuss their shared vision and message to the team they 39 d do it all with a common goal of changing the way folks think about the detroit lions a mission they set out to accomplish back in january 2021 five years later the game they always knew would come is here it doesn 39 t make it any easier 34 he 39 s one of my brothers man 34 campbell told the athletic 34 he 39 s a brother and i have an immense amount of respect and love for aaron glenn 34 campbell pauses he takes a moment his knee is restless he fidgets with a rolled up practice schedule his voice cracks ever so slightly as he searches for the words 34 for him to get that job 34 he says 34 it was one of the happiest days of my life and it was one of the hardest days of my life 34 on sunday campbell 39 s lions will face glenn 39 s jets for the first time it will be bittersweet for both men as campbell 39 s defensive coordinator from 2021 24 glenn helped establish one of the most successful tenures in franchise history he was campbell 39 s right hand man closest confidant and sounding board he was a dear friend campbell in turn looked out for glenn he thought about his future perhaps long before glenn himself did he stood by him through early struggles as this franchise figured things out his patience was rewarded and he now follows his friend 39 s career from afar with pride though they 39 re no longer side by side they remain forever linked campbell lived out in the texas country glenn in houston campbell 39 s father larry was a no nonsense marine turned cattle rancher who put his kids to work you could typically find him in cowboy boots and a belt buckle seemingly big enough to spot from college station glenn 39 s father a c was a subcontractor who worked 12 hour shifts to support a family of 11 children he made it his mission to pass down his work ethic to his kids two sides of the same coin really 34 i told people i wasn 39 t into rehab i wanted to go recruit good guys the culture was so important to me 34 r c slocum the legendary former texas a amp m head coach says now 34 i wanted guys to come in and be a part of something bigger than themselves and be team players and both of those guys fit the mold to a t 34 slocum recruited glenn the undersized cornerback who never backed down from a challenge and campbell the physical tight end with a heart of gold to a amp m though their time at college station didn 39 t overlap aggies tend to cross paths sooner or later during a visit to a amp m as a high school senior in 1993 campbell attended an aggies game against louisville at the time a amp m had a cannon that fired after every touchdown the home team scored campbell heard it often that day a 42 7 rout with a little more than six minutes to go in the third quarter campbell remembers louisville qb jeff brohm dropping back and firing off a pass intended for wr kevin cook glenn jumped it returning the interception 40 yards for a pick 6 as he sprinted into the end zone taunting brohm by showing him the ball on his way glenn turned his attention to the cannon and pointed at it 34 he runs over there and points at the cannon and it goes off man 34 campbell says 34 he was just electric 34 jason glenn looked up to his big brother the whole neighborhood did really his mindset made him different he was a fighter from houston to college station to the nfl 34 ag was big on action 34 jason says 34 ag just backed it up 133 i 39 m not gonna say too much to you you 39 re just gonna feel it 34 jason would eventually follow in his brother 39 s footsteps committing to a amp m without needing much of a pitch from slocum and while a seven year age gap prevented the glenn brothers from playing together at a amp m jason formed a bond with campbell years before aaron did as a freshman at a amp m jason remembers the aggies running a 9 on 7 drill nine defenders seven offensive players it 39 s a drill designed to emphasize the run game coaches called for jason a converted safety to take the field at linebacker for the first time his assignment taking on a 6 foot 5 blocking tight end from glen rose texas jason didn 39 t back down he made quick work of campbell no small feat back then made the tackle and started talking smack as his teammates and coaches hyped him up he let everyone have it then campbell let him have it 34 you 39 re like 39 o k this is a pup 39 34 campbell recalls smiling at the memory 34 he gives you this move and you 39 re like 39 oh man 39 but yeah i got him back 34 says jason 34 dan you can tell he 39 s kinda pissed so i get back in there and i try to do the same exact move dan grabbed me under my armpit picked me up and put me on my back i 39 m getting up i 39 m fighting him i 39 m on my back punching him he 39 s punching me and it 39 s this huge brawl 34 not campbell 39 s first certainly not his last the part jason will never forget came next when practice ended jason was still heated campbell sought him out and put an arm around him little glenn campbell told him you 39 re gonna be ok bill parcells used to say about young players that 34 if they don 39 t bite when they 39 re puppies they usually don 39 t bite 34 he knew that campbell had some bite to him it 39 s how offensive coordinator sean payton convinced parcells to add him as one of the first free agents the cowboys signed when parcells was hired as head coach in 2003 sometimes parcells felt the need to let campbell off his leash it was for a good cause if there was an opponent on the cowboys 39 schedule viewed as easy the proverbial cupcake he needed to ensure his players 39 level of intensity rose above that expectation so early in practice parcells would call campbell over assistant coaches and teammates watched and wondered what parcells was saying to him they quickly found out 34 i want to nip this in the bud 34 parcells would tell campbell 34 so i want you to go over there and start something with one of those guys 34 sometimes the coach would pick out a player for campbell to target sometimes it was campbell 39 s choice the end goal was the same glenn laughs 34 he was the guy that parcells used to use to piss somebody off 34 glenn said at a recent news conference 34 there were a number of fights in practice because of him 34 says campbell 34 i normally didn 39 t have any problem stirring it up a little bit so yeah that was one of my jobs 34 the brouhaha would lead to a fiery competitive practice just like parcells wanted later in the cafeteria or in the locker room campbell would find the teammate he started something with pull up a chair and sit with him cracking jokes and laughing as if nothing happened he could disarm anyone with his charm even if he 39 d just thrown them to the ground he never fought glenn though campbell was a self described 34 grunt 34 so his fights were mostly reserved for linebackers and defensive linemen but it struck glenn how campbell managed to cut any sort of tension with his teammates that stuck with him campbell and glenn had known each other for years at that point but it was in dallas that their friendship really started to bloom it was rooted in their relationships with parcells the two were among the favorites the hard nosed parcells ever coached it was no small feat to break through with the legendary coach 34 when you 39 re coaching players you get to know them not just as football players you get to know them as people 34 parcells told the athletic 34 and we just got along always i had a high regard for those guys 34 glenn 39 s relationship with parcells famously didn 39 t start off that way when parcells became jets coach in 1997 glenn stormed into his office demanding to know if parcells planned on trading him because at 5 foot 9 glenn didn 39 t have the size parcells preferred in his cornerbacks parcells told him he 39 d trade anyone even his own mother if the price was right but that glenn had nothing to worry about if he did his job glenn made the pro bowl in 1997 and again in 1998 the jets became winners so started a lifelong friendship and mentorship lessons learned that glenn still carries with him now when glenn hit free agency in 2005 after eight years with the jets and three more with the expansion houston texans parcells prioritized adding him in free agency bringing a veteran he trusted onto a roster that already had campbell and keyshawn johnson one of glenn 39 s closest friends from the jets days teammates for the first time campbell and glenn hit it off immediately 34 he 39 d get there early like i would 34 campbell says 34 you work out and man you get in the hot tub early we had one of those huge big ol 39 round hot tubs the thing takes up a whole freaking room there 39 s a ton of guys that get in there to warm your body up and you 39 d be in there and you 39 re talking and talking about family and you 39 re talking about a amp m and you 39 re talking about new york and life and the opponent that 39 s where you build a bond 34 campbell remembers a 2005 game against the giants campbell 39 s old team during which glenn primarily a nickel corner at that point had to play outside for an injured terence newman that meant a matchup with 6 foot 5 plaxico burress glenn first picked off eli manning in the end zone later he jumped burress 39 s route picked manning off again and set up a cowboys touchdown 34 he played out of his mind 34 campbell says 34 he studied the heck out of tape he was just outstanding 34 parcells used to tell payton that players who lasted for 14 15 16 years 34 always knew who they were 34 glenn played for 15 years his last with payton and the saints in 2008 34 as gifted and as skilled as glenn was man there 39 s a grinder element and a work element to him and a toughness and mental toughness to him 34 payton told the athletic last year 34 when you start combining all those things you end up with one of these special people 34 payton needed a defensive backs coach in 2016 so he hired glenn to a staff that already had campbell coaching tight ends 34 i just knew the upside 34 payton said 34 the same thing i felt with campbell 34 new orleans proved to be the perfect incubator for campbell the saints were a fresh start he 39 d served as the miami dolphins 39 interim head coach in 2015 but was passed over for the permanent job for glenn it was a promotion he was now running his own dbs room on a staff with payton campbell and defensive coordinator dennis allen another aggie some days campbell would walk into glenn 39 s office in new orleans and just start asking him about defensive schemes they 39 d talk about the game plan trade notes about what an upcoming opponent was doing coverage wise or pressure wise sometimes campbell would pull up three plays of the opponent 39 s defense and ask glenn what he was seeing glenn 39 s diagnosis was always prompt 34 something you 39 re studying for hours trying to grasp he could diagnose in minutes 34 campbell says glenn would do the same thing he 39 d ask campbell about attacking protections or what offenses were looking at in certain situations 34 you 39 re just constantly growing together 34 campbell says 34 he 39 s a football junkie like i am so that 39 s just fun he could talk ball all day 34 that 39 s what glenn thought they were doing talking ball turns out it was more than that really campbell had visions of becoming a head coach again one day and wanted to figure out if glenn would be a good fit as his defensive coordinator he was interviewing him without telling him 34 i just thought we were talking philosophy the whole time 34 glenn says in 2019 two years before campbell secured the lions job he interviewed with multiple teams for head coaching positions campbell didn 39 t want to get glenn 39 s hopes up before he landed a job and he didn 39 t want to go behind payton 39 s back without asking him first but eventually he ran the idea by glenn glenn 39 s answer still sticks with campbell today 34 i would love to be your defensive coordinator 34 campbell remembers glenn telling him 34 but i 39 m not ready yet 34 glenn felt like he needed to learn the nuances of run plays of protections of responsibilities outside of the scope of a defensive back coach 39 s frame of reference the response only made campbell want him more 34 this guy knows exactly who he is 34 campbell says 34 it takes a lot of guts to do that to know yourself man those are the great ones 34 it didn 39 t hurt that over the course of five years as the saints 39 defensive backs coach he 39 d built his unit into one of the best in the nfl a key component of a defense that routinely ranked among the league leaders in takeaways he won over players with his energy and coaches with his work ethic and football acumen the front office appreciated his eye for scouting talent linebacker demario davis credits glenn with convincing the saints to sign him as a free agent davis earned two pro bowl and a first team all pro nod in eight seasons in new orleans hall of fame quarterback drew brees played with both glenn in 2008 and campbell 2009 at the end of their careers and they became coaches on payton 39 s staff toward the end of his playing career 34 those are two of my favorite guys in all of football 34 brees says 34 i think they 39 re both those types of guys that get so much respect from players because they not only played the game but played it at a really high level and they did it the right way they 39 re great coaches and teachers in a number of different ways but they just garner so much respect i think they 39 re both pretty emotional guys from the perspective that they 39 re very authentic in the things that they say and the things that they do 34 there 39 s nothing fake about it 34 for about a week in january 2021 campbell and glenn pretty much lived in the lions coaching offices campbell was the new head coach his first move was to hire glenn as his defensive coordinator it was a leap of faith to the outside world hiring someone who had never done that job before it didn 39 t feel like that to campbell 34 i 39 m like man how long did you guys have this planned 34 jason says laughing 34 you knew it was just a matter of time before those two got together and started building something special 34 they formulated a plan campbell spent more time in glenn 39 s office than his own talking about staff discussing attitude the types of players they wanted the identity they would build for the organization they 39 d start early in the morning and stay through the night 34 we would grind man 34 campbell says 34 it was just him and i in the freaking lab going to work 34 says glenn 34 we talked football and how we were going to change this program around those things will always stick with me because the things that we talked about we actually did 34 a 3 13 1 debut season didn 39 t faze them nor did a 1 6 start in 2022 with many in detroit calling for glenn 39 s head as the defense sank to the bottom of most statistical rankings 34 i never lost faith in him 34 campbell says 34 i knew he was the right man to sit in that seat i never wavered from that and i knew he would get it right and he 39 s just too good of a man too good of a coach everybody respects him and he doesn 39 t get down in the dumps when things get worse that 39 s when he rises up and he 39 s at his best and that 39 s the type of human being he is anybody would go to war for aaron glenn 34 that bond was at the core of the turnaround the lions went 8 2 after that 1 6 start just missing out on a playoff berth the next year they went 12 5 and made it all the way to the nfc championship game the success was linear and they achieved it together campbell often would let glenn lead team meetings and act as the head coach it was to serve as a training exercise but also because campbell knew he would say the right thing 34 dan let ag be ag because they have a great relationship 34 says former lions cornerback amik robertson 34 when you talk to them you see the same thing 133 when ag takes the floor it 39 s like dan is taking the floor they 39 re like kobe and shaq 34 the 2024 season was when glenn won over jets brass too some in the front office now still talk about the way glenn 39 s defense handled itself as his unit was decimated by injuries it 39 s a sentiment shared by those in detroit who lived it the lions had the best regular season in franchise history they had the league 39 s best offense they won 15 games and their second consecutive nfc north title securing the nfc 39 s no 1 seed but it was never that easy for glenn at one point 16 of glenn 39 s defensive players landed on ir including starters like aidan hutchinson alim mcneill carlton davis alex anzalone and derrick barnes it was a nightmare scenario for most coordinators glenn was tasked with holding it together with duct tape and rubber bands wide receiver tim patrick then with the lions and now with the jets said he 39 d see tryout players coming in on tuesday and wednesday and many of them wound up playing significant roles by sunday glenn got them ready 34 it don 39 t matter who comes in who plays we 39 re gonna find a way to win and we did that 34 lions all pro linebacker jack campbell says of glenn 39 s message that season 34 i feel like people just got behind that because he was just so good at adjusting to the personnel and what players 39 strengths were 34 the lions defense that year ranked in the top 10 in points per game allowed rushing defense third down defense fourth down defense and red zone defense what glenn did with that unit earned him looks from almost every organization in search of a new head coach however the injuries proved to be too much to overcome in the postseason the lions ran out of steam in a 45 31 divisional round playoff loss to the commanders 34 at the end of the day man he was hurt 34 jason glenn says 34 like he was hurt from that game and that 39 s the side that people do not see away from the cameras with him 34 it was glenn 39 s final game in detroit glenn walked out of the jets building in florham park in january 2025 with his dream job offer in hand then he took a private plane back to detroit and made the trip to the lions 39 facility he walked around and thanked those in the building for their role in helping him get to this point the next head coach of the new york jets it was in those hallways and offices in allen park that glenn and campbell came together to formulate a plan to fix a downtrodden franchise that they cared about deeply glenn brought those lessons with him to new jersey his journey with the jets has started down a similar road they went 3 14 in glenn 39 s first season many fans quickly turning on him he 39 s stayed true to himself though to what he knows and to what he 39 s learned the noise rarely makes it to his ears he is resolute in his belief in his plan their plan 34 you can 39 t let this job change who you are 34 parcells says 34 you have to be dan campbell you have to be aaron glenn and you have to communicate the way you 39 re used to communicating they 39 re both direct forward speaking guys i 39 m just like a father proud of his kids that 39 s what it 39 s like for me 34 campbell can reminisce these days about those meetings in glenn 39 s office football conversations about their shared philosophies and what they hoped to accomplish and did accomplish together 34 it 39 s hard to lose a guy like that you know 34 campbell says it still isn 39 t easy sunday won 39 t be either this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.body_text: there s no way to sugarcoat it injuries have sucked a lot of air out of the balloon that is the young season that s not just from a fantasy perspective every football fan wants to watch caleb williams jayden daniels brock bowers and puka nacua on sundays the sport is better when those guys are playing but in fantasy we strategically picked guys like nico collins saquon barkley and dj moore to help us win our leagues now we have to hear the friend who autodrafted boast about being 2 0 not ideal this makes finding sneaky values that much more important not every addition has to be a league winner my goal right now is to get you those week winning stopgaps while your stars are on the mend with that being said welcome to the infirmary of week 3 note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Can 49ers' Brock Purdy prevail over team's toughest opponent, the injured list?
news_mentions.body_text: santa clara calif this is the brock purdy era his teammates tell us and it 39 s a good thing because once again the san francisco 49ers 39 toughest opponent will be their own injured list the number of players on it would have grown to 16 on friday after news arrived that defensive end nick bosa strained a calf doing high knees before thursday 39 s practice he is out for sunday 39 s game against the arizona cardinals and will miss 34 a few weeks 34 coach kyle shanahan said friday that normally would mean bosa would go on the injured reserve list for four weeks 133 133 but there is no vacancy at the er sorry the ir the 49ers are running out of spots and general manager john lynch will have to make like dr robby to juggle which eight players that 39 s the limit he and shanahan want to activate during the regular season while receiver ricky pearsall tight end jake tonges and defensive tackle alfred collins are out for the season the niners expect to bring back receivers de 39 zhaun stribling and christian kirk as well as offensive lineman austen pleasants and defensive tackle c j west rookie defensive end romello height who had hand surgery is not on the list but is also out sunday as is rookie defensive tackle james thompson shanahan was asked after practice if it feels like groundhog day 34 losing bosa was rough yesterday he said 34 losing six out of the 10 d linemen in the last two weeks that had made our team is a little unusual i don 39 t think i 39 ve been a part of that so that has been different 34 the 49ers were already thinking about not putting receiver demarcus robinson ankle on the injured reserve list but now they may have to rather than carry his and bosa 39 s dead roster spots for three to four weeks defensive end mykel williams coming off knee surgery was designated physically unable to perform before training camp so he is on a different list he is expected to start practicing again next week if the 49ers were at one point curious what second year linebacker nick martin or veteran cornerback nate hobbs could bring to the mix after they healed that might now be tabled until next season the 49ers are well ahead of last year 39 s ridiculous injury pace the neighboring substation ghosts are chuckling while the trainers may be facing some uneasy questions so luxury moves are out with 15 games still left and 133 what will the 49ers 39 defense look like without bosa against the cardinals denver broncos and seattle seahawks over the next three weeks we heard from a couple of general managers at the spring owners 39 meetings that while linebacker fred warner is indeed special it 39 s bosa who makes the 49ers 39 defense go with his pass rush and run defense now the 49ers will likely have to start khalid kareem 28 opposite keion white on the edges with bosa and height out it will be the second career start for kareem who took a last minute flight to australia for the 49ers 39 opener after being signed three weeks ago rookie gracen halton will start inside next to osa odighizuwa with naquan jones signed off the minnesota vikings 39 practice squad wednesday backing them up purdy keeps getting better and more confident according to lynch despite losing four of his top five receivers entering training camp he 39 s completed 80 percent of his passes and thrown five touchdown passes to help the 49ers start 2 0 they 39 re averaging 31 points a game and purdy and company put up 41 points the last time he faced the cardinals 34 he looked like he was just at practice out there wheeling and dealing 34 left tackle trent williams said after sunday 39 s win over the miami dolphins 34 we 39 re starting to witness brock 39 s prime and i think it 39 s going to be a sight to behold 34 the cardinals 39 defense is built on disguises with fourth year coordinator nick rallis often using three safeties and post snap rotations to confuse offenses that works better against teams who don 39 t face them twice a season the 49ers meanwhile have a lot of the same pieces but their offense is always evolving for example they 39 re using even more pre snap motion or lining up in shotgun only a league low 39 percent of the time down from 53 percent last season 34 if you look at the niners 39 offense compared to two years ago 34 tight end george kittle said 34 it 39 s completely different besides our basic lineup and running outside zone everything 39 s so different now all of our motions and gaps and how we structure plays and play action everything is so different 34 kyle 39 s offense has grown and changed so much 34 so has purdy who is living up to his preseason pledge to make more plays with his feet he ran for 30 yards and a touchdown sunday and the play of the day was a rollout to his left on which he pumped faked across his body before dropping a perfect 27 yard pass to mike evans in a tight window 34 brock has that special ability to play within the scheme and then know when to play football like you do when you 39 re a kid 34 running back christian mccaffrey said 34 there 39 s a good balance of doing your job and being extremely detailed on what 39 s asked of you but the play might not be there and you gotta go make a play 34 brock 39 s always looking for that and seems to always find it 133 that 39 s what makes him elite 34 it also helps his teammates relax when purdy never seems to get nervous or stressed 34 he 39 s always that guy you can look to in the middle of a game and get that calmness from no matter how the game is going 34 williams said 34 he 39 s got so much composure and focus 34 i respect that about him the most i know his job comes with the most pressure 34 especially when he keeps having to learn new teammates 39 names this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top
