news_mentions.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Ravens vs. Cowboys: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro
news_mentions.description: Is Ravens RB Derrick Henry about to run over the Cowboys once again? Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines for Sunday's game between Baltimore and Dallas in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back in brazil this week for the third straight season once again pitting two high profile clubs in front of some of the world s most passionate fans it s a recipe for electric football but there are a few notable differences this time around for one after two years in sao paulo the league is making its regular season debut in brazil s second largest city rio de janeiro and its most iconic venue the maracana home to some of the most memorable moments in brazilian sporting history two world cups with unfortunate exits for the selecao the 2016 summer olympics the maracana used to hold nearly 200 000 spectators jerry jones cowboys who play in one of the nfl s largest stadiums will feel right at home in the cavernous confines the capacity is just over 73 000 nowadays but the roar undoubtedly remains another change after being played in friday week 1 island windows in 2024 and 25 this year s brazil game will kick off at 4 25 p m et on a sunday right in the middle of a four game late slate no offense to the cardinals 49ers vikings buccaneers raiders and saints but most eyes will be on baltimore and dallas in rio and deservedly so boasting two of the most explosive offenses and marketable quarterbacks in today s nfl the ravens and cowboys enter their international outing with somewhat disappointing 1 1 records and a lot to prove after a week 1 road rout of indianapolis baltimore blew a second half lead at home against the saints in week 2 the cowboys conversely were run over by the rival giants in week 1 only to crush the visiting commanders the following sunday both considered playoff division and super bowl contenders baltimore and dallas have a lot to work out in the season s early goings and will be doing so this week in unfamiliar territory the ravens are playing only their third ever game overseas while the cowboys will be embarking on just their second international voyage three must know storylines 1 is derrick henry due for another big day vs dallas d tractorcito bem vindo ao brasil the ravens running back hulking at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds is set up for a monster day at the maracana as long as baltimore leans on the back in crunch time through two weeks henry ranked second in the league with 212 rushing yards while tying for the nfl lead with four scores on the ground the tailback might have been even more productive if he had received more than five carries in the second half of the ravens week 2 loss when the saints came back from an 11 point first half deficit the perfect remedy after last week s disappointing finish could be a date with the cowboys defense led by first year dc christian parker dallas hasn t stopped a nosebleed through two weeks ranking 29th in yards allowed per game 391 5 and 30th in rushing yards allowed per game 173 5 the cowboys are also dead last in third down conversion rate allowed 68 0 a bruiser like henry and an escape artist like lamar jackson are nightmares for a defense like dallas which struggled to contain cam skattebo and jaxson dart in week 1 allowing the giants to control the clock and salt away a win while the cowboys offense had two second half possessions just two years ago henry rolled over dallas to the tune of 174 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns with jackson tallying 87 yards and a td on the ground as well will the ravens runners have similar outings in the southern hemisphere this sunday 2 can the cowboys continue to roll offensively if week 1 was a liar as they say was week 2 the truth for the cowboys it s tough to say this early in the season with dallas jekyll and hyde offense the cowboys scored on seven of their eight drives against washington in their home opener and have consistently cooked defenses under brian schottenheimer all of which made their season opening dud in east rutherford see 244 total yards all the more surprising after the ravens struggled to defend through the air against chris olave juwan johnson and devaughn vele in week 2 dallas will look to hammer baltimore s dbs with a heavy dose of ceedee lamb and george pickens a dynamic duo that only occasionally has a case of the dropsies and tight end jake ferguson the key for the ravens will be getting pressure on dak prescott so far this season the qb has been beating the blitz with ease 78 3 completion percentage third in nfl but when under pressure he has struggled 50 his lowest mark since 2019 per nfl pro baltimore s defense boasts a 43 8 pressure rate this season the fifth highest in the nfl and has pressured qbs on 65 0 of third down dropbacks highest in the league if dallas can avoid third and long situations it may have a field day against baltimore but jesse minter s defense led by kyle hamilton roquan smith trey hendrickson and potentially nnamdi madubuike who might make his season debut on sunday will do its best to keep the cowboys behind the chains 3 play action advantage for baltimore playing off its success in the ground game baltimore could enjoy a big day in the play fake game against dallas through two games this season lamar jackson has completed 13 of his 18 play action pass attempts for an nfl high 229 yards while also taking off to run on four play action dropbacks for 36 scramble rush yards the top total in the league off play action per nfl pro meanwhile his opponent on sunday has allowed qbs to target a receiver with 3 plus yards of separation on 12 of 17 play action attempts this season 70 6 the second highest rate in the nfl and has also yielded a league high 61 scramble yards on play action dropbacks 24 more than the next closest team while jackson is making fewer plays on designed runs this year he remains the nfl s great improviser the dallas defense is determined to stay disciplined but with the unit struggling against play action baltimore s two time league mvp could break open the game either through the air or on the ground total football in brazil s cathedral of futebol

news_mentions.headline: Bengals backup Joe Flacco doesn't expect trade to Giants after Jaxson Dart injury: 'Not true'
news_mentions.description: Bengals backup Joe Flacco’s ties to Giants coach John Harbaugh make the 41-year-old an interesting trade target. However, Flacco doesn’t plan on leaving the Queen City.
news_mentions.body_text: with jaxson dart out for the season and jameis winston struggling in his stead the rumor mill has churned out potential trade options for the new york giants should winston continue to look like a player who spent his summer on the world cup tour cincinnati bengals backup joe flacco s ties to john harbaugh from their time in baltimore make the 41 year old an interesting target however flacco doesn t plan on leaving the queen city it s obviously not real and not true flacco told kelsey conway of the cincinnati enquirer about trade rumors but it was good enough to get people like certain friends of mine to get them to text me hey i ll see you in new york i was like no guys you won t that s not true given joe burrow s injury history it makes little to no sense for the bengals to trade flacco even with a veteran like josh johnson on the practice squad if burrow goes down for a spell flacco is the best option to keep things afloat i just get a kick out of it he said i haven t really given it too much thought at this point last year flacco wasn t aware he was being traded from cleveland to cincinnati so anything can happen but there is minuscule incentive for the bengals to trade their top backup or the giants to part with an asset for a 41 year old who isn t going to change their season long trajectory regardless of his relationship with the head coach in these cases it s not up to me flacco said i m on the cincinnati bengals and because of that that s my focus being here doing the things that i need to do to get better each day while i m here make sure i m absorbing the game plan and all of those things i get a little bit of a kick out of it but it s kind out of my hands i m a cincinnati bengal and i m doing everything i can to get ready for the pittsburgh steelers the giants recently gave winston an extension he ll get a chance to run the offense before new york hits the panic button if winston is so awful that big blue is desperate for qb help the season is probably lost anyway backups with experience like flacco will always be named as potential candidates whenever a starter goes down just because there are speculative rumors doesn t mean a trade makes sense for either party

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs want to lighten Kenneth Walker's workload after 56 touches in two games
news_mentions.description: Kenneth Walker III has rejuvenated the Kansas City offense, bringing a tackle-breaking ground element that had been missing. The Chiefs, however, know they mustn’t grind the RB into the ground.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker has rejuvenated the kansas city chiefs offense bringing a tackle breaking ground element that had been missing the chiefs however know they mustn t grind the rb into the ground coach andy reid said this week the club would like to reduce walker s workload a little bit heading into week 3 walker led the nfl with 290 rushing yards and 369 scrimmage yards in 2026 two touchdowns after thursday night football bijan robinson now leads with 349 and 467 respectively walker s rushing yard tally marks the most by any nfl player through two weeks since c j spiller in 2012 292 walker is on pace for 2 465 rush yards which would be an nfl record by 360 yards he s also tied with jahmyr gibbs with 56 scrimmage touches we re lucky to have him running backs coach demarco murray said thursday via espn he s a great leader and he s done a great job for us he s prepared himself for this workload since the spring coach reid puts a great training camp together and the long drive drill is legendary around here walker likes the ball a lot walker s 369 scrimmage yards are the second most by a player in his first two games with a team in the super bowl era only billy sims had more with the lions the back has forced 29 missed tackles in 2026 per next gen stats most through two weeks in ngs era the key is balance and ensuring walker who never played a full 17 game slate before last season remains healthy to that end the chiefs plan to give rookie emmett johnson who has also flashed tackle breaking acumen more run we just want to continue to make sure we re bringing our rookies along the right way offensive coordinator eric bieniemy said thursday emmett s role is to continue to grow as the season progresses what you don t want to do when you re raising some of these young players is put them in a situation where it could be detrimental to them you want them feeling free and confident through two games johnson has generated 10 rushes for 39 yards and four catches for 64 yards 103 scrimmage yards the plan is to get the rookie more carries starting with sunday s game against the miami dolphins i want kenneth to get into a groove and it s hard to kind of take him out murray said but emmett s done a great job and he s still learning he ll continue to get more opportunities i ve just got to pull the trigger and get no 9 walker out of there and put no 10 johnson in there

news_mentions.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
news_mentions.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad, 35-14, as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was the return of michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of its first three games by at least 17 points in 2026 it is the first time the packers have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in prime time since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday the packers missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is cripplingly bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing eight of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on nine carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

news_mentions.headline: Falcons-Packers on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Atlanta's 35-14 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down the top takeaways from the Atlanta Falcons' 35-14 win over the Green Bay Packers for their first victory of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: bijan shines in prime time again michael penix was back on thursday night but more importantly bijan robinson returned to prime time one of the greatest talents in the nfl has a history of showing out under the lights and he did so again on thursday night football propelling the falcons to their first win of what has been a dismal season entering week 3 atlanta hadn t scored a touchdown since a week 1 first quarter catch by robinson from cooper rush robinson ended that streak with a 3 yard td in the opening quarter thursday which began a scoring surge for the falcons of 27 straight points after his 213 scrimmage yards thursday he s averaging 145 4 scrimmage yards per prime time game which is tops in nfl chronicle minimum five games his last appearance in prime time was in a stunning week 17 upset of the rams last season striding for a 93 yard touchdown amid a 229 scrimmage yard showing on thursday he rushed for 194 yards and two touchdowns on 29 carries while hauling in two passes for 19 yards it was a more pivotal performance than last season though atlanta was off to a disastrous start over two ugly games all is not puppies and rainbows now but when you ve got one of the best players in the game hope is always on the roster that showed in spectacular fashion home not so sweet home despite a rough 1 1 start to the year the packers surely would find solace in their cozy confines of lambeau field against a winless falcons squad right nope for the first time since 2012 the packers lost their home opener snapping an nfl long 13 game winning streak it was an insulting footnote to a rather horrendous evening for green bay all around missing micah parsons knee and josh jacobs commissioner s exempt list and with the offensive line depleted the packers struggles were all too familiar for this still infant season jordan love was under consistent duress and frequently inaccurate the running game was next door to non existent 17 net yards the defense did no favors either allowing a woebegone falcons offense to run and pass wild with robinson and drake london each turning in near 200 yard performances a mini bye lies ahead for the packers giving them some extra time to figure out how to salvage a quickly sinking ship penix settles in during debut on a long road back from an acl tear last season penix made his 2026 debut thursday night he struggled early looking terrible at times frankly as he was skittish in the pocket and worried into myriad bad throws he completed only one of his five pass attempts with an interception over atlanta s first two drives with robinson setting the tone though penix settled in and the offense was better for it particularly london who had a career high 194 yards on nine catches sparked by the sensational play of robinson the falcons truly found their rhythm when penix did he finished with 256 yards on 18 of 25 passing with a 5 yard touchdown pass to austin hooper it was rough early accentuated by penix throwing a bad interception to xavier mckinney on the fourth play of the game it ended very well however penix was the third qb to play for atlanta this season and the second to start perhaps the position is solidified at least for the immediate future no love for jordan up front with starters aaron banks and zach bako bewele out thursday night and bako bewele gone for the year the packers offensive line woes were exasperated thursday love was under siege and inaccurate which has been a problem for three weeks now the problems that have plagued the packers offense all season are clear a porous offensive line a non existent running attack and a quarterback who s been misfiring likely as a byproduct of the issues surrounding him love who entered the game with an nfl worst 52 1 completion percentage among qualified starters was 28 of 53 52 8 for 312 yards just 5 9 yards per attempt with one touchdown and an interception he was only sacked once but atlanta had 12 qb hits and 23 qb pressures 41 8 pressure rate meanwhile marshawn lloyd was the team s leading rusher with 11 yards on four carries in contrast to the green bay defense allowing 242 yards on the ground to atlanta second year wide receiver matthew golden had five catches for 100 yards and a touchdown it was his first td and 100 yard showing of his career both looming large as there was little on thursday night for the packers to look at optimistically for what lies ahead henderson falcons d step up for as lackluster as the packers offense was credit does need to go to the falcons defense cornerback c j henderson the 2020 nfl draft s no 9 overall pick who s now playing for his third team stepped in for an injured a j terrell and played excellent ball for the most part the packers targeted him 12 times but he came up with three passes defensed and allowed five catches for 52 yards jalon walker s gone for the season due to injury and james pearce continues to serve his suspension but cameron thomas six qb pressures sack and co made life difficult all night for the opposition jeff ulbrich s defense allowed just 328 yards to the packers at lambeau field that s a heckuva first win and a defensive performance to build on next gen stats insight for falcons packers via nfl pro bijan robinson s 55 yard run in the first quarter the longest of the season so far in the nfl saw him run a total distance of 89 6 yards nfl research kevin stefanski earned his first win with the falcons and it came with michael penix s first start of the year penix is the 15th quarterback to start a game for stefanski and the 11th to win a game for the former browns coach in 104 career games

news_mentions.headline: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. moves on from contract talks, offers no firm timeline for return
news_mentions.description: Joey Porter Jr. hasn't yet suited up for the Steelers this season but has attracted plenty of attention for his absence.
news_mentions.body_text: joey porter has not yet suited up for the steelers this season but has attracted plenty of attention for his absence he finally addressed the contract and health related matter thursday downplaying the drama that has followed him since the start of training camp in short he s working his way back to the field and is no longer concerned with the financial standoff that lurked beneath his injury report status it didn t get done it didn t happen porter said of his desired contract extension adding he did not request a trade that s really just old news for me now it s mainly just focus on what i ve got ahead of me and just really getting back to 100 porter is not currently at 100 percent but is gradually improving from a persistent back injury that sidelined him for all of training camp he s also still trying to work his way into football shape after spending the summer preparatory period on the physically unable to perform list this isn t a matter of simply taking a few days off to get right it s a complex multi faceted situation that should benefit from a longer timeline to return even if that clashes with the win now environment that is the nfl regular season it s both porter who was limited again in thursday s practice said of his injury and his conditioning my back has its moments where it flares up here and there we re still just trying to get my conditioning down to me just being out there as much as possible it s really just both porter said he ll definitely play at some point this season but wasn t willing to commit or comment on an outlook beyond thursday he did toss in some good news though his absence hasn t strained his relationship with his teammates no i love all my guys and my guys love me too porter said so they re here for me and i m there for them i m just trying to be a good motivator to all the young guys and even the o g s in here those teammates will continue to carry on without him hopefully it won t be too long before he rejoins them porter s steelers 1 1 host the rival bengals 2 0 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett defends Marvin Harrison Jr. amid criticism of slow start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals WR Marvin Harrison has just one catch through two games to start the season. QB Jacoby Brissett defended the wideout when talking to reporters on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: arizona cardinals wide receiver marvin harrison is now in year three of his nfl career and is still hearing the same questions why aren t you more involved in the offense where are the big plays we were promised through two games this season harrison has seen just four targets he s caught one a fantastic snag down the sideline in week 1 for 33 yards production that doesn t match his status as the no 4 overall pick in the 2024 draft pressed for answers after seeing just one target in arizona s lopsided week 2 loss to seattle harrison explained it as a matter of circumstance it s definitely a combination of a lot of things harrison told reporters on wednesday via espn for my route tree getting down the field you need a lot of things to go right you need the right coverage you need protection to hold up you need me to run a great route you need obviously jacoby brissett to make the right pass and make the right read so i feel like it s never one person s fault for anybody s success or lack thereof really so i think it s always a combination of a bunch of things and whether that s a lack of success or success in general it doesn t help that despite spotty at best production harrison is seen as arizona s most dangerous threat in the cardinals receiving corps which will draw additional attention from opposing defenses in arizona s week 1 win over the chargers los angeles only left him on an island in single coverage on seven of the 33 routes he ran he won his only press man matchup a situation in which his size and route running gives him an advantage on the sideline grab his lone contribution to arizona s season opening highlight reel brissett meanwhile leaned heavily on tight end trey mcbride in both games capitalizing on coverage mismatches to the tune of nine completions for 95 yards and a touchdown in week 1 in their low output week 2 contest mcbride was arizona s passing offense logging the most targets 10 and catches 8 for 41 yards and his second touchdown of the season it s clear brissett prefers the playmaking tight end as a reliable target but harrison still looms as a big play threat if given the opportunities which were sparse in their 31 7 loss to the defensively driven reigning champions this past sunday pretty much that simple harrison said seattle s a really good defense and you don t want to give a lot of teams especially a rival team a lot of credit but when you just look across the league they re far beyond above everybody else especially on the defensive side of the football so things like that happen if it were the first slow start for harrison folks might give him grace but through two seasons and the first two weeks of 2026 harrison s productivity hasn t come close to matching his expectations previous struggles were partially pinned on arizona s instability at quarterback with kyler murray s health challenges limiting his availability and hindering their chances of establishing a rapport defensive minded coach jonathan gannon s presence also gave cardinals an easy excuse now though the underwhelming performances are rising to a concerning level coach mike lafleur brings the offensive expertise for which cardinals fans previously yearned yet the initial returns remain the same for harrison he hears the criticism fortunately he also has the support of his quarterback is some of the noise justified brissett said i don t think so personally we just signed mike wilson for 25 million and nobody said anything about him having two catches i think people try to find somewhere to make something out of nothing the only thing you can do is just go out there and just continue to get better as a teammate of him and him as an individual and i think that s what we re doing harrison is no stranger to the spotlight he arrived at ohio state as a top recruit succeeded stars garrett wilson chris olave and jaxon smith njigba the 2025 nfl offensive player of the year in columbus and knew he d be a top pick in the 2024 nfl draft he just hasn t delivered on those expectations yet no he said when asked if he was surprised by the public reaction to his slow start i mean i understand who i am and what i was expected to do when i got drafted here and all the expectations that were put on me and i think people want certain production so when that s not happening everybody s going to ask questions or figure out why is that the reason and so i wouldn t say i m surprised by anything that s talked about me anyway fortunately he still has 15 more games this season to prove them wrong

news_mentions.headline: Chargers QB Justin Herbert rejects leadership concerns: 'I trust those guys in that locker room'
news_mentions.description: When a team starts 0-2, it’s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback. That’s what’s happening in Los Angeles, where Justin Herbert's winless Chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned.
news_mentions.body_text: when a team starts 0 2 it s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback that s what s happening in los angeles where the winless chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned that specific query is what set off justin herbert on wednesday i think that happens regardless i think our team is so close and so i don t think there s a lack of vocal leadership at all an especially stern herbert said when asked if the team lacked a vocal leader so i think i m going to stop you right there and say that it s very present we ve got great leadership on this team i trust those guys in that locker room and so i don t think anyone is panicked or worried because that s not going to do us any good it s moving on to the next play and understanding we re close we ve made mistakes how do we fix them how do we move on mistakes have been plentiful for the chargers who have committed 15 accepted penalties for 109 yards and given away possession five times in two games those numbers don t account for the dropped passes either like the sharp throw from herbert that tight end david njoku bobbled into the hands of las vegas raiders cornerback hezekiah masses in week 2 simply the chargers have been an operational mess through two weeks herbert has had his positive moments but he too has made mistakes unnecessarily forcing passes in winnable games that have resulted in tide turning interceptions the upgraded offense that was supposed to come with the arrival of coordinator mike mcdaniel has failed to materialize and los angeles has scored just 28 points in two games i think anytime you learn a new offense um you re gonna have times where you re gonna just want to do your best and make sure that you re doing everything you can to be at your best herbert said so no i think every nfl offense is a complicated one but i think it s just on us to be studying our stuff making sure that we re ready to go the last line in herbert s response is intriguing if not illuminating the chargers have appeared anything but prepared to start this season getting outplayed and outcoached by an underdog arizona cardinals team that rolled into sofi stadium in week 1 and gleefully punched the bolts in the mouth the raiders enjoyed similar success in week 2 capitalizing on busted coverages poor discipline and even worse execution that made them look like the superior team too it s incredibly far from the standard coach jim harbaugh has set in los angeles since he arrived in 2024 and with the chargers schedule significantly increasing in difficulty starting in week 3 the pressure is on i think it s just about us being at our best learning and continuing to get better doing what we re coached to to be at our best herbert said they ll need to be at their peak sunday when they head to buffalo to face the red hot bills otherwise herbert will field more of the same frustrating questions again next week

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
news_mentions.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can with what you have right now where you re at winston and the giants 1 1 host the titans 0 2 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Bills QB Josh Allen, 49ers QB Brock Purdy highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: San Francisco signal-caller Brock Purdy and Buffalo quarterback Josh Allen were among the half-dozen players lauded Wednesday for their Week 2 heroics.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 2 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week allen has been a scoring machine so far this season and on thursday he opened up the new highmark stadium with a resounding five touchdown performance in the bills 41 31 victory over the lions through the air allen had three touchdowns and 248 yards while he had 69 yards and two more tds on the ground through two games allen has piled up five passing tds and four scores on the ground incredibly this is allen s 19th afc player of the week honor which is tied for 14th all time and trails only aaron rodgers 27 among active players nfc offensive player of the week pinpoint accuracy and stellar numbers have marked purdy s performance over two games this season in sunday s 35 13 thrashing of the miami dolphins purdy was 20 of 22 90 9 for 287 passing yards and two touchdowns so far he leads the nfl with an 80 4 completion percentage and has thrown for five tds and 492 yards the nfc west is loaded with talent and had a string of stellar week 2 showings from the rams matthew stafford 327 passing yards four td passes and davante adams eight receptions for 195 yards two tds along with the seahawks jaxon smith njigba nine catches for 155 yards three tds but it was the efficiency of purdy that news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL Mexico City pregame entertainment announced
news_mentions.description: The NFL announced that acclaimed Música Mexicana artist Majo Aguilar and Oakland-born Blaxicana singer-songwriter MXKA will perform the national anthems of Mexico and the United States prior to the 2026 NFL Mexico City Game
news_mentions.body_text: the national football league today announced that acclaimed musica mexicana artist majo aguilar and oakland born blaxicana singer songwriter mxka will perform the national anthems of mexico and the united states prior to the 2026 nfl mexico city game between the minnesota vikings and san francisco 49ers on sunday nov 22 at 7 20 p m ct 8 20 p m et at estadio banorte majo aguilar will perform the mexican national anthem and mxka will perform the u s national anthem one of the leading contemporary voices in musica mexicana majo aguilar blends mariachi with a modern artistic vision a three time latin grammy nominee for best ranchero mariachi album and a two time consecutive premio lo nuestro winner for mexican music female artist of the year she has become a leading figure in the genre s new generation her acclaimed mariachi mio project helped redefine mariachi through contemporary influences while performances at mexico city s zocalo teatro metropolitan and canelo alvarez s boxing match in riyadh have further elevated her profile with more than 533 million global streams aguilar continues to celebrate mexican culture and bring the richness of musica mexicana to audiences worldwide i feel very happy to be able to perform the mexican national anthem mexico is a beautiful country with a rich culture said majo aguilar thank you to the nfl for inviting me to be part of such a special moment and allowing me to represent my country it fills me with pride to be mexican mxka moh kah is an oakland born blaxicana singer songwriter whose music blends the storytelling and instrumentation of musica mexicana with the melodic intimacy of contemporary r b a sound she calls r b tumbados born to a mother from mexico city and a father from louisiana she creates bilingual music that reflects her black mexican and american identities her breakout single la vuelta marked a major step in her growing career with her work also earning recognition from spotify billboard kqed and remezcla she has also performed the national anthem as part of telemundo s official fifa world cup 2026 coverage and continues to expand the boundaries of contemporary latin music through her unique cross cultural perspective getting to sing the u s national anthem in mexico city with the 49ers on the field is a moment that connects so many parts of my story said mxka i was born in oakland my mom is from cdmx and as a blaxicana artist i m proud to carry both my black and mexican roots onto a stage this big i m deeply grateful to the nfl for trusting me with this moment and i can t wait to share it with fans from mexico the bay and everywhere in between on aug 31 it was announced that the warning will headline the halftime show of the 2026 nfl mexico city game the mexico city performance is one of a record seven halftime shows presented by american express staged across the 2026 international games a lineup of musical performances spanning seven countries and four continents as the league plays its most international games ever in a single season we are excited to showcase two artists in majo aguilar and mxka pregame in mexico city each who have rich and significant connections to the country said tim tubito nfl senior director event and game presentation their powerful renditions of the mexican national anthem and the u s national anthem under the lights at estadio banorte will set the stage for the nfl s return to mexico city both the mexico and u s anthems along with the full halftime show will be broadcast live in mexico on televisaunivision s channel 5 and on espn the league is committed to growing the game at every level across mexico engaging fans year round through partners programs and initiatives further information around the entertainment and fan events surrounding the 2026 nfl mexico city game will follow soon tickets for the 2026 nfl mexico city game are on sale now at nfl com mexicocity to stay up to date on all things nfl mexico and for more on the 2026 nfl mexico city game follow nflmx on instagram x and tiktok sixty two regular season nfl games have been played outside the united states with london berlin munich frankfurt madrid dublin sao paulo mexico city and toronto having hosted games to date

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys defense hopes to stay 'disciplined' vs. Lamar Jackson after struggling with mobile QBs
news_mentions.description: The Cowboys head to Brazil this week to face Lamar Jackson and the Ravens in the NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro. The revamped Dallas D understands it has its hands full attempting to slow Jackson & Co.
news_mentions.body_text: the dallas cowboys head to brazil this week to face lamar jackson and the baltimore ravens in the nfl s first ever game in rio de janeiro the revamped dallas defense understands it has its hands full attempting to slow jackson and co we all know what it is cowboys pass rusher donovan ezeiruaku said via the team s official website you guys know we know as players the type of guy he is somebody who can throw the ball but also run the ball at a very high level it s easier to say than to do but our job is to go out there and go do that s what we re tasked with jackson leads the nfl with 10 0 pass yards per attempt through two weeks the qb hasn t run a ton 11 carries for 74 yards and a touchdown but has looked more spry when he has taken off than a year ago the cowboys must key on his scrambling ability after struggling to stop qb runs in the first two weeks against jaxson dart 11 54 and jayden daniels 7 69 the cowboys have allowed the most rushing yards to quarterbacks in the nfl 126 on 19 carries 6 6 ypc that figure would have been even worse had daniels not exited last sunday s game at halftime with an elbow injury dallas must make a more concerted effort to slow jackson just being disciplined cowboys defensive tackle kenny clark said communication just understanding our rush lanes playing with extension powering offensive linemen and just restricting those gaps so you can t get through but the main thing is just staying disciplined and communicating the ravens missing zay flowers due to a hamstring injury weren t as explosive in week 2 but the combination of jackson and derrick henry will always trouble defenses despite just five carries in the second half on sunday henry has 212 rush yards and four rush tds through two games he s tied for the nfl lead in tds and only kenneth walker 290 has more rush yards slowing both jackson and henry in the same game is a monumental task for any defense it is very unique ezeiruaku said for a guy who s probably bigger than me playing running back you ve got to take out the legs that s the only way to stop a guy like that from running the ball easier said than done like it is with lamar but it ll be a really good challenge on paper it s a rough matchup for dallas defense which through two games hasn t shown significant improvement from a year ago under christian parker too many mental mistakes remain there is a lack of pass rush and the tackling is mediocre dallas enters sunday s tilt ranked 32nd in third down percent allowed 68 30th in rush yards per game allowed 173 5 29th in yards per game allowed 391 5 29th in sacks 24th in yards per play allowed 5 8 18th in points per game 24 0 and 17th in pass yards per game 218

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks to undergo surgery, miss at least six weeks
news_mentions.description: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks has experienced another bump in the road. Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core muscle injury, which will land him on IR.
news_mentions.body_text: panthers running back jonathon brooks has experienced another bump in the road brooks is expected to undergo surgery on wednesday to repair a core muscle injury which is expected to keep him out at least six weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported per sources the carolina ball carrier was placed on injured reserve on wednesday knocking him out for at least four games panthers coach dave canales said brooks is expected to miss six to eight weeks brooks left early in sunday s win over the atlanta falcons and did not return it s the latest blow for the 2024 second round pick who has dealt with a litany of injuries dating back to college after missing the start of his rookie season while rehabbing a torn acl brooks took just nine carries over three games before tearing the knee ligament again he missed all of 2025 brooks returned this offseason with renewed optimism that he could be the player the panthers envisioned when they selected him with a second round pick in his first two games of the 2026 season he touched the ball 11 times for 73 yards given the buoyancy the coaching staff had when discussing brooks this offseason noting he finally looked like the player they saw on his college film the latest injury is a bummer for the back it s a reminder that getting healthy and staying healthy are two different burdens the hope is that brooks can return healthy later in the season and provide some pop out of the backfield in the meantime chuba hubbard will continue to shoulder the load with veteran aj dillon as the backup the panthers are working out veteran austin ekeler aaron wilson of kprc 2 in houston reported wednesday ekeler 31 played in two games in 2025 before tearing his achilles if healthy ekeler could potentially be a pass catching option alongside bryce young

news_mentions.headline: George Kittle on 2-0 49ers' offense: It's 'a dream come true'
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers have put up 62 points in two blowout wins to open the season and Brock Purdy has yet to be sacked as Kyle Shanahan's offense is rolling.
news_mentions.body_text: venturing from san francisco to australia and back to the bay it s been a blissful two weeks to start the season for george kittle and the 49ers first was a 27 7 blowout of the rival los angeles rams in the nfl s historic australian debut next was a walloping of the miami dolphins 35 13 for kittle playing in the current 49ers offense is a complete delight i got really lucky kittle said tuesday on the rich eisen show i get to play with trent williams right we got him hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still mike evans hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still and so just when you add guys like that it s just so much fun cause i mean every time we call a play and i know mike has a chance of getting the ball i m like this is so sick brock purdy s throwing the ball to mike evans and i m blocking for him what a dream come true kittle a seven time pro bowler noted that outside of the wide receiver room highlighted by offseason signee evans the 49ers offense is mostly a collection of familiar talent and it s going glowingly thus far i think the biggest thing is that this is essentially like the same offense we ve had for quite a while now said kittle who had four receptions for 80 yards and a touchdown against the dolphins it s the same starting o line as last year it s the same quarterback the same fullback the same running back the same tight ends the wide receiver room has changed a little bit deebo samuel s been a part of it before i think mike evans would work in any offense because of how good he is with purdy off to a sensational start having yet to be sacked and leading the nfl with an 80 4 completion percentage whilst throwing five touchdowns the 49ers are indeed humming kittle stressed a game by game approach and outlook underscoring that their week 3 tilt against the arizona cardinals would be a tough one at the moment however kittle s smiling wide it s a good time to be a 49er the niners are playing well feeling good about ourselves right now he said football s fun isn t it

news_mentions.headline: Ex-Ravens RB Jamal Lewis on Derrick Henry's lack of carries in loss: 'Don't make that mistake again'
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry received just five carries in the second half of Sunday's loss to the New Orleans Saints.
news_mentions.body_text: a bruising baltimore ravens running back of the past is confused by the use or lack thereof of a charm city standout of the present in the aftermath of derrick henry getting just five carries in the second half of the ravens 24 17 loss to the new orleans saints on sunday baltimore s all time leading rusher jamal lewis was blunt in his criticism of the approach he s a workhorse lewis said on the bmore football podcast you re not going to have a workhorse like that for long so you better use him henry 32 finished the week 2 defeat with 16 carries for 68 yards and a touchdown henry had rushed for 51 yards and a 1 yard touchdown on 11 carries as baltimore held a 14 6 halftime advantage in the second half he was given just five totes and earned 17 yards and the ravens squandered a lead that was as wide as 11 points in the opening half baltimore getting away from giving henry the ball has been a curious occurrence at times dating back to john harbaugh s reign in the 2025 ravens win or go home week 18 battle against the pittsburgh steelers for instance henry had 15 carries for 112 yards in the first half but was given the ball just five times in the second half of the 26 24 loss it was confusing for many then and it remains a conundrum now if i only got the ball 10 times in the second half i was pissed off said lewis who admitted it was a much different situation when he played than for henry who lines up in the backfield with lamar jackson the most prolific rushing quarterback in nfl history lewis still remains the ravens leading rusher with 7 801 yards like henry lewis has a 2 000 yard season to his credit unlike henry lewis owns a super bowl ring if henry jackson and baltimore are to contend for a lombardi trophy lewis is of the mind that ravens first year offensive coordinator declan doyle will need to feed the rock to henry more often in two plus seasons with henry playing for the ravens baltimore is 12 3 when the two time rushing champion has 20 plus carries it s 1 0 this year after he rumbled for 144 yards on 24 carries in a 41 23 season opening win against the indianapolis colts hopefully the offensive coordinator and the head coach learn from the mistake being that it is early in the season lewis said don t make that mistake again the ravens are headed to brazil this week to take on the dallas cowboys who have given up more rushing yards this season than all but two other teams it portends to be a prime opportunity for head coach jesse minter and his staff to heed lewis advice

news_mentions.headline: Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri kicks world record field goal in Swiss Alps
news_mentions.description: Hall of Fame kicker Adam Vinatieri earned a spot in the Guinness World Record book with his latest feat.
news_mentions.body_text: adorned with four super bowl victories three pro bowls and more than 2 600 points scored adam vinatieri was basking in the warmth of a canton ohio summer day back in august just more than a month later vinatieri was bundled up back to kicking and setting a record the hall of famer who played 10 seasons with the new england patriots and 14 more for the indianapolis colts set a guinness world record on tuesday for kicking the highest field goal in the world converting from an altitude of 3 454 meters 11 332 feet above sea level in the swiss alps the 53 year old vinatieri s kick took place at jungfraujoch known as the top of europe on snow covered ground with swirling winds snow is simply part of my time with the patriots said vinatieri who converted plenty of kicks in snowy conditions during his career including in the 2001 season s afc championship game against the raiders but kicking a field goal at 3 454 meters is something completely different from anything i ve ever done you feel the altitude with every breath you take your heart rate is different your rhythm is different and no one can really tell you beforehand how it will affect the kick because no one has done this before the fact that we were able to set the record under these conditions makes me very proud vinatieri split the uprights in front of a small but joyous gathering having made his last official nfl kick on dec 1 2019 for the colts vinatieri s latest boot was official according to guiness it also came with him donning a patriots jersey as part of the patriots countdown to their nov 15 game in munich against the detroit lions

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top
