news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 3 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Will the Lamar Jackson's Ravens or Dak Prescott's Cowboys prevail in Brazil? Who takes a compelling Sunday night clash between the Rams and Broncos? Which 0-2 teams could get in the win column? Check out the Week 3 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 3 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 24 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 27 why bobby picked the bills fool me once shame on you fool me twice shame on me i will not be picking the chargers for a third straight week nor am i likely to throw my support behind them very much at all in the coming months considering the juggernauts lined up to face them first up on that list the bills who look to be the cream of the afc crop in the early goings of this season josh allen is on fire having already accounted for nine touchdowns five passing four rushing while leading buffalo to 36 or more points in each of the team s first two games while there are some pressing questions about the bills defense nothing has come easy to the chargers in mike mcdaniel s new scheme justin herbert looks uncomfortable his pass catchers have been affected by multiple big drops and injuries and lead back omarion hampton has lost a fumble in both games there s nothing to suggest los angeles can string together enough scoring drives to keep up with buffalo s mighty offense look for the bills to move to 3 0 in dominating fashion why bobby picked the panthers cleveland s upset victory over the buccaneers felt more like tampa bay continuing to be the team that fell on its face throughout the end of last season than a sign the browns will stick it to another nfc south opponent lest that be misconstrued as a browns is the browns take cleveland played well and fought hard for its win deshaun watson was as precise as he s been in years rookie denzel boston looks like a stud and the browns defense was the far more composed side during the game s final two minutes in the aftermath of a 132 minute weather delay the panthers just happen to be playing better ball than both the bucs and the browns bryce young is off to the best start of his career buoyed by the budding wide receiver duo of tetairoa mcmillan and jalen coker he s averaged 324 passing yards through two games with three touchdown passes in each contest it s not out of the question he keeps it going against a cleveland defense still navigating the early days of the post myles garrett era the wild card remains the panthers defensive jekyll and hyde act to start the season are they the closer to the group that gave up 59 points to an explosive bears team in the opener or the unit that dominated a woeful falcons squad while allowing just 3 points even if it s more the former dave canales offense should be able to do enough for a victory why jeremy picked the lions aaron glenn s return to detroit where he was dan campbell s defensive coordinator for four seasons will be the ultimate test for his jets defense s early turnaround after games against the titans and packers offenses asterisk needed gang green s defense which received an influx of veteran talent in the offseason ranks in the top three in yards per game 197 0 first yards per play 4 0 third and third down conversion rate 23 8 second new york will be without a few injured vets in the motor city but should get back joseph ossai for sunday s game whether glenn s jets feast depends on which lions team shows up detroit has a talent advantage on offense but has yet to play a complete game this season nearly blowing week 1 against new orleans forgetting to show up until the second half of the bills loss the lions defense is banged up but so is new york s receiving corps detroit s best bet sunday is getting to geno smith with aidan hutchinson and co the qb hasn t turned the ball over yet but he s faced a 43 4 pressure rate second in the nfl only to the injured jayden daniels and the veteran is due despite his claims otherwise as week 2 proved the jets still need to learn how to win new york is close but the lesson won t come this week against a tested lions team why gennaro picked the texans is this an elimination game in september as the only week 3 matchup between winless teams this afc south showdown screams desperation since 1990 just 2 9 percent of squads that lost their first three games went on to make the playoffs we re talkin five out of 171 people of course last year s texans were one of those five and while houston s hyped defense looked shockingly porous against josh allen s bills in week 1 the unit largely stifled joe burrow and the bengals last sunday i anticipate continued success against a one dimensional colts offense jonathan taylor s a stud no doubt but he has to be a one man army with daniel jones still seemingly working his way back from last december s achilles tear add in the fact that indianapolis 114 million field stretcher just hit injured reserve and houston can commit additional resources to stopping the colts bell cow back meanwhile indy s defense hasn t been able to stop anyone giving up the second most yards ever in the first two weeks of a season 1 2016 raiders 1 035 yards allowed 2 2026 colts 1 029 t 3 1967 falcons 1 025 t 3 2017 saints 1 025 oddly enough the two bookends on that list the 2016 raiders and 2017 saints both made the playoffs with double digit wins maybe the colts have everyone right where they want them or maybe they re doomed to suffer a sixth straight loss to c j stroud and co why dan picked the jaguars there will be no sneaking up on anyone for this season s jaguars and patriots not after they both surprised in 2025 sunday s meeting is an opportunity to establish which squad has more staying power in the afc s upper ranks and the trenches might dictate which team has the edge jacksonville needs better play from the offensive line especially on the interior if it s going to bounce back from blowing a lead against denver new england has a duo that can exploit a team s weakness up the middle with milton williams and christian barmore at defensive tackle one thing that could work in the jags favor is the pats ailing health new england has taken hits to the league s no 1 scoring defense edge rusher dre mont jones and safety craig woodson missed wednesday s practice with shoulder issues and lost rg mike onwenu ankle to injured reserve i m leaning ever so slightly toward the home team in what figures to be a highly entertaining battle why gennaro picked the chiefs two weeks ago we didn t really know what to expect from kansas city the chiefs were coming off their first losing campaign under andy reid while patrick mahomes was returning from knee surgery two games into the season it feels like the team and the quarterback are back whole different story in miami we all knew the 2026 dolphins would be bad that s what happens when a new regime takes the roster down to the studs and carries a whopping 183 7 million in dead money but this feels like a dead team walking what does miami do well without any established firepower beyond rb de von achane the offense can t sustain drives the defense had no answer for raiders rb ashton jeanty in week 1 and nearly allowed a perfect game from 49ers qb brock purdy in week 2 so the better question might be what does miami do this is a rebuilding team without an identity that doesn t play well against a resurgent power with hall of fame leadership yes this is miami s home opener and kansas city s first road game no i don t think that completely flips the script in the fins favor why gennaro picked the titans both teams are coming off a loss but their vibes couldn t be more different tennessee gave philadelphia all it could handle in a 24 20 defeat instilling confidence in the young titans that they can compete with real super bowl contenders a true moral victory new york on the other hand suffered extreme agony in defeat the giants not only lost to the rams by 22 points but they lost jaxson dart to knee surgery john harbaugh had a thousand yard stare after the second year quarterback went down on monday night and now he has to steer the ship without his best defensive player too as brian burns is reportedly set to miss time with an ankle injury remember all that hope following new york s season opening win over dallas consider it dashed the g men just experienced a devastating gut punch and i think the effects carry over into sunday s game against a suddenly frisky foe you know tennessee oc brian daboll would love to knock off the team that fired him last november and while head coach robert saleh failed to exact his revenge on the jets in week 1 he d undoubtedly enjoy notching his first win as titans head coach in his old home of metlife stadium why brooke picked the bengals cincinnati is seeing the fruits of its offseason labor defensively and perhaps no player has been more influential to his new team than dt dexter lawrence through two weeks according to ngs with lawrence on the field the defense has generated a 45 2 pressure rate allowed 2 9 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 58 3 of carries without him on the field cincy has generated a 35 1 pressure rate allowed 5 6 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 21 4 of carries sexy dexy s influence bodes well for a bengals team heading into a hostile road environment to face an offense in which the qb and play caller don t appear to be on the same page even if pittsburgh gets michael pittman foot back this unit doesn t strike fear in anyone right now and isn t likely to keep up with joe burrow ja 39 marr chase and the bengals oh so explosive offense there s a lot of pressure on the steelers eighth ranked overall and scoring defense to make plays it ll make its fair share but ultimately it won t be enough one nfl pro insight matchup to watch bengals lt orlando brown vs steelers olb alex highsmith brown has allowed a pressure on 13 of his pass blocks against the steelers in 13 career games including the postseason the highest rate he has allowed against any opponent min 100 pass blocks that rate jumps to 15 1 if you limit it to browns time with the bengals six games against pittsburgh meanwhile highsmith has generated 24 pressures against brown including 16 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds the fourth most quick pressures by any pass rusher against a single blocker since 2018 nick herbig has added 13 pressures and three sacks on 78 matchups against brown why dan picked the seahawks just when it seemed like the commanders were starting to cook on offense they are forced once again to face life without jayden daniels who has now had more dislocations of his left elbow than any person should ever have to experience unfortunately for backup qb marcus mariota his return to a starting role coincides with a visit from arguably the league s most ferocious defense the 2026 seahawks are one of just five defenses since 2010 to allow fewer than 20 points and fewer than four yards per play over their first two games of a season per nfl research each of the previous four teams to do so won 11 or more games it s true that seattle might be trotting out its own backup qb for the second week in a row but drew lock has proven a tremendous fill in for sam darnold editor s update on friday seahawks coach mike macdonald announced that sam darnold is returning to the starting lineup on sunday there s always the threat of a west coast team being discombobulated by a cross country trip but i m not paying it any mind in this case the seahawks are 7 0 in road games that kicked off at 1 p m et under head coach mike macdonald why jeremy picked the 49ers no team is having an easier start to the season than san francisco blowout victories over the jet lagged rams and doe eyed dolphins have the 49ers playing out of this world even when they re on the other side of it in come the cardinals who after a week 1 upset over the potentially fraudulent chargers were who we thought they were against the cream of the nfc west crop in the seahawks the 49ers pose a similar problem to arizona as the hawks did and with brock purdy in the zone the result should be similar expect san francisco to control sunday s game from the jump but just miss out on winning their straight game by at least 20 points thanks to garbage time heroics by trey mcbride and michael wilson why brooke picked the vikings there s early concern around zac robinson s offense in tampa my colleague nick shook s assessment of baker mayfield under his nth oc said it all the veteran qb is uncomfortable in this scheme at this juncture having to right the ship against a blitz happy vikings defense feels like an uphill climb despite mayfield performing well in such situations of late when blitzed this season he has a 68 8 success rate the second highest among qualified qbs per ngs that s a big jump up from his 39 3 mark in 2025 the third lowest if baker can navigate brian flores ferocious front deciphering when the no nonsense dc is sending the house or dropping guys into coverage the bucs should stay competitive i would have argued that tampa has the upper hand if carson wentz were starting but praise jesus we don t have to watch that stuck in the mud quarterback this week with kyler murray set to return we should finally get a better idea of what kevin o connell s offense looks like at close to full strength that ll be especially true if todd bowles defense continues to underperform cleveland s deshaun watson had his best outing in years against the bucs last week and to make matters worse first round edge rusherrueben bain s status is uncertain these teams are trending in opposite directions heading into this nfc clash why bobby picked the saints raiders saints might be the most underrated matchup on the week 3 docket new orleans an overtime two point conversion away from being 2 0 hosts a las vegas squad that remains unbeaten heading into late september the raiders have been playing winning football and doing so without tight end brock bowers who is expected to return from a knee injury sunday but it does come off as more of a mirage than what the saints have been doing while kirk cousins is tied for the nfl lead with six touchdown passes and the defense ranks fifth in points allowed with a league best 45 6 pressure percentage per pro football reference such success has so far come against the rebuilding dolphins and a chargers team in a tailspin even with the loss against the lions new orleans boasts the more impressive resume following its comeback victory over the ravens tyler shough has exhibited an excellent rapport with his top three pass catchers chris olave devaughn vele and juwan johnson he also appears to have the clutch gene after storming back from 21 down to force detroit to overtime and overcoming an 8 point fourth quarter deficit in the win over baltimore if the saints can keep shough comfortable against maxx crosby and co admittedly a big if with left tackle kelvin banks ankle out indefinitely the second year quarterback can be trusted to deliver again in new orleans 2026 home opener why jeremy picked the cowboys how do you say points in portuguese two of the league s most exciting offenses have the potential to produce a classico at the maracana on sunday in only its second international game dallas is looking to export its week 2 bounce back performance over the equator with possession dak prescott s attack proved what it s capable of against washington after their snf snoozer lamar jackson derrick henry and friends will hope to play keep away from dallas as the giants did in week 1 but if zay flowers hamstring misses a second straight game baltimore s aerial attack could be neutered again against a cowboys defense that hasn t found its footing yet under new coordinator christian parker as long as both teams actually have proper footing on the brazilian turf they should tear up and down the field but it ll be dak and dallas with more points in the end if the ravens had trouble with chris olave down the stretch in week 2 just think of the problems they ll encounter covering two olaves in ceedee lamb and george pickens in week 3 why gennaro picked the rams the super bowl lx matchup that wasn t eight months ago the rams and broncos suffered narrow defeats on championship sunday leaving both painfully short of the lombardi trophy game then they opened this season by hitting the road and humiliating themselves on national television both returned to form at home in week 2 though setting up a compelling clash worthy of the sunday night stage showcasing a pair of super bowl winning head coaches and two of the league s most well rounded rosters this game doesn t lack for star power and yet i see its outcome hinging on the rams meat and potatoes kyren williams and blake corum with eerily similar frames games and jersey numbers 23 and 24 l a s two backs are difficult to tell apart and so is their robust ground production through two games williams 23 rushes for 126 yards 5 5 per attempt and a touchdown corum 22 rushes for 133 yards 6 0 per attempt i see los angeles blue collar backfield playing a leading role in this prime time tilt denver cleaned up its tackling last week after an embarrassing display against kansas city s kenneth walker but i still think this front s susceptible to the run free agent departure john franklin myers got 63 million for a reason monday sept 28 why dan picked the eagles questions about the bears quarterback situation linger over what had previously looked like a juicy matchup bathed in prime time allure caleb williams is dealing with the hamstring injury he suffered last week and his backup tyson bagent is in the concussion protocol which means 38 year old third stringer case keenum is in line to start for chicago on monday night if williams and bagent can t go keenum hasn t played in a regular season game since 2023 when he threw one touchdown pass and three interceptions in two starts for the texans it s not hard to envision philadelphia defensive coordinator vic fangio rubbing his hands together in glee at his good fortune potentially missing out on having to game plan against one of the league s most dynamic young qbs and his capable backup the eagles have the lowest point differential 6 of any 2 0 team and struggled to put away the titans who haven t been competitive in years so while they might not be firing on all cylinders it will take an even larger letdown than the team s performance on black friday last year when the bears ran wild over philly to open the door for keenum to pull off the upset it looks like we re about to find out if ben johnson can perform miracles thursday s game why brooke picked the packers the packers lucky to eke out a victory in new york to avoid falling to 0 2 finally return to beloved lambeau field where they have won each of their last 13 home openers i have concerns about jordan love s o line which just lost starting right tackle zach bako bewele for the season and has others banged up og aaron banks ot anthony belton and backup ol donovan jennings love has already taken seven sacks tied for third most faced the fifth highest pressure rate in the nfl this season 42 3 and is tied for the most unblocked pressures faced 12 per nfl pro how matt lafleur game plans for his shorthanded offense against a falcons defense that ranks first against the run ninth on third down and in the red zone and has generated pressure on 41 5 percent on dropbacks seventh in the nfl per next gen stats could tell part of thursday night s story not having cb a j terrell hurts atlanta s chances of slowing christian watson and matthew golden but having michael penix under center should be a boon for that team even if he s still knocking off the rust this should look like a more competent unit one that s better suited to get bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts more involved these are two flawed teams and though i think we ll see an improved falcons outfit green bay has a much needed home field edge and a defense that s playing with confidence with budding star lukas van ness at the forefront clean up the penalties and this could be a turning point for the pack visit
