news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: New Orleans Saints training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the New Orleans Saints' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the new orleans saints offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location ochsner sports performance center metairie louisiana fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at los angeles chargers 4 05 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 10 week 2 vs jacksonville jaguars 1 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 17 week 3 vs denver broncos 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the saints are one of just three teams browns titans that do not have a prime time game on their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 3 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Will the Lamar Jackson's Ravens or Dak Prescott's Cowboys prevail in Brazil? Who takes a compelling Sunday night clash between the Rams and Broncos? Which 0-2 teams could get in the win column? Check out the Week 3 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 3 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 24 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 27 why bobby picked the bills fool me once shame on you fool me twice shame on me i will not be picking the chargers for a third straight week nor am i likely to throw my support behind them very much at all in the coming months considering the juggernauts lined up to face them first up on that list the bills who look to be the cream of the afc crop in the early goings of this season josh allen is on fire having already accounted for nine touchdowns five passing four rushing while leading buffalo to 36 or more points in each of the team s first two games while there are some pressing questions about the bills defense nothing has come easy to the chargers in mike mcdaniel s new scheme justin herbert looks uncomfortable his pass catchers have been affected by multiple big drops and injuries and lead back omarion hampton has lost a fumble in both games there s nothing to suggest los angeles can string together enough scoring drives to keep up with buffalo s mighty offense look for the bills to move to 3 0 in dominating fashion why bobby picked the panthers cleveland s upset victory over the buccaneers felt more like tampa bay continuing to be the team that fell on its face throughout the end of last season than a sign the browns will stick it to another nfc south opponent lest that be misconstrued as a browns is the browns take cleveland played well and fought hard for its win deshaun watson was as precise as he s been in years rookie denzel boston looks like a stud and the browns defense was the far more composed side during the game s final two minutes in the aftermath of a 132 minute weather delay the panthers just happen to be playing better ball than both the bucs and the browns bryce young is off to the best start of his career buoyed by the budding wide receiver duo of tetairoa mcmillan and jalen coker he s averaged 324 passing yards through two games with three touchdown passes in each contest it s not out of the question he keeps it going against a cleveland defense still navigating the early days of the post myles garrett era the wild card remains the panthers defensive jekyll and hyde act to start the season are they the closer to the group that gave up 59 points to an explosive bears team in the opener or the unit that dominated a woeful falcons squad while allowing just 3 points even if it s more the former dave canales offense should be able to do enough for a victory why jeremy picked the lions aaron glenn s return to detroit where he was dan campbell s defensive coordinator for four seasons will be the ultimate test for his jets defense s early turnaround after games against the titans and packers offenses asterisk needed gang green s defense which received an influx of veteran talent in the offseason ranks in the top three in yards per game 197 0 first yards per play 4 0 third and third down conversion rate 23 8 second new york will be without a few injured vets in the motor city but should get back joseph ossai for sunday s game whether glenn s jets feast depends on which lions team shows up detroit has a talent advantage on offense but has yet to play a complete game this season nearly blowing week 1 against new orleans forgetting to show up until the second half of the bills loss the lions defense is banged up but so is new york s receiving corps detroit s best bet sunday is getting to geno smith with aidan hutchinson and co the qb hasn t turned the ball over yet but he s faced a 43 4 pressure rate second in the nfl only to the injured jayden daniels and the veteran is due despite his claims otherwise as week 2 proved the jets still need to learn how to win new york is close but the lesson won t come this week against a tested lions team why gennaro picked the texans is this an elimination game in september as the only week 3 matchup between winless teams this afc south showdown screams desperation since 1990 just 2 9 percent of squads that lost their first three games went on to make the playoffs we re talkin five out of 171 people of course last year s texans were one of those five and while houston s hyped defense looked shockingly porous against josh allen s bills in week 1 the unit largely stifled joe burrow and the bengals last sunday i anticipate continued success against a one dimensional colts offense jonathan taylor s a stud no doubt but he has to be a one man army with daniel jones still seemingly working his way back from last december s achilles tear add in the fact that indianapolis 114 million field stretcher just hit injured reserve and houston can commit additional resources to stopping the colts bell cow back meanwhile indy s defense hasn t been able to stop anyone giving up the second most yards ever in the first two weeks of a season 1 2016 raiders 1 035 yards allowed 2 2026 colts 1 029 t 3 1967 falcons 1 025 t 3 2017 saints 1 025 oddly enough the two bookends on that list the 2016 raiders and 2017 saints both made the playoffs with double digit wins maybe the colts have everyone right where they want them or maybe they re doomed to suffer a sixth straight loss to c j stroud and co why dan picked the jaguars there will be no sneaking up on anyone for this season s jaguars and patriots not after they both surprised in 2025 sunday s meeting is an opportunity to establish which squad has more staying power in the afc s upper ranks and the trenches might dictate which team has the edge jacksonville needs better play from the offensive line especially on the interior if it s going to bounce back from blowing a lead against denver new england has a duo that can exploit a team s weakness up the middle with milton williams and christian barmore at defensive tackle one thing that could work in the jags favor is the pats ailing health new england has taken hits to the league s no 1 scoring defense edge rusher dre mont jones and safety craig woodson missed wednesday s practice with shoulder issues and lost rg mike onwenu ankle to injured reserve i m leaning ever so slightly toward the home team in what figures to be a highly entertaining battle why gennaro picked the chiefs two weeks ago we didn t really know what to expect from kansas city the chiefs were coming off their first losing campaign under andy reid while patrick mahomes was returning from knee surgery two games into the season it feels like the team and the quarterback are back whole different story in miami we all knew the 2026 dolphins would be bad that s what happens when a new regime takes the roster down to the studs and carries a whopping 183 7 million in dead money but this feels like a dead team walking what does miami do well without any established firepower beyond rb de von achane the offense can t sustain drives the defense had no answer for raiders rb ashton jeanty in week 1 and nearly allowed a perfect game from 49ers qb brock purdy in week 2 so the better question might be what does miami do this is a rebuilding team without an identity that doesn t play well against a resurgent power with hall of fame leadership yes this is miami s home opener and kansas city s first road game no i don t think that completely flips the script in the fins favor why gennaro picked the titans both teams are coming off a loss but their vibes couldn t be more different tennessee gave philadelphia all it could handle in a 24 20 defeat instilling confidence in the young titans that they can compete with real super bowl contenders a true moral victory new york on the other hand suffered extreme agony in defeat the giants not only lost to the rams by 22 points but they lost jaxson dart to knee surgery john harbaugh had a thousand yard stare after the second year quarterback went down on monday night and now he has to steer the ship without his best defensive player too as brian burns is reportedly set to miss time with an ankle injury remember all that hope following new york s season opening win over dallas consider it dashed the g men just experienced a devastating gut punch and i think the effects carry over into sunday s game against a suddenly frisky foe you know tennessee oc brian daboll would love to knock off the team that fired him last november and while head coach robert saleh failed to exact his revenge on the jets in week 1 he d undoubtedly enjoy notching his first win as titans head coach in his old home of metlife stadium why brooke picked the bengals cincinnati is seeing the fruits of its offseason labor defensively and perhaps no player has been more influential to his new team than dt dexter lawrence through two weeks according to ngs with lawrence on the field the defense has generated a 45 2 pressure rate allowed 2 9 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 58 3 of carries without him on the field cincy has generated a 35 1 pressure rate allowed 5 6 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 21 4 of carries sexy dexy s influence bodes well for a bengals team heading into a hostile road environment to face an offense in which the qb and play caller don t appear to be on the same page even if pittsburgh gets michael pittman foot back this unit doesn t strike fear in anyone right now and isn t likely to keep up with joe burrow ja 39 marr chase and the bengals oh so explosive offense there s a lot of pressure on the steelers eighth ranked overall and scoring defense to make plays it ll make its fair share but ultimately it won t be enough one nfl pro insight matchup to watch bengals lt orlando brown vs steelers olb alex highsmith brown has allowed a pressure on 13 of his pass blocks against the steelers in 13 career games including the postseason the highest rate he has allowed against any opponent min 100 pass blocks that rate jumps to 15 1 if you limit it to browns time with the bengals six games against pittsburgh meanwhile highsmith has generated 24 pressures against brown including 16 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds the fourth most quick pressures by any pass rusher against a single blocker since 2018 nick herbig has added 13 pressures and three sacks on 78 matchups against brown why dan picked the seahawks just when it seemed like the commanders were starting to cook on offense they are forced once again to face life without jayden daniels who has now had more dislocations of his left elbow than any person should ever have to experience unfortunately for backup qb marcus mariota his return to a starting role coincides with a visit from arguably the league s most ferocious defense the 2026 seahawks are one of just five defenses since 2010 to allow fewer than 20 points and fewer than four yards per play over their first two games of a season per nfl research each of the previous four teams to do so won 11 or more games it s true that seattle might be trotting out its own backup qb for the second week in a row but drew lock has proven a tremendous fill in for sam darnold editor s update on friday seahawks coach mike macdonald announced that sam darnold is returning to the starting lineup on sunday there s always the threat of a west coast team being discombobulated by a cross country trip but i m not paying it any mind in this case the seahawks are 7 0 in road games that kicked off at 1 p m et under head coach mike macdonald why jeremy picked the 49ers no team is having an easier start to the season than san francisco blowout victories over the jet lagged rams and doe eyed dolphins have the 49ers playing out of this world even when they re on the other side of it in come the cardinals who after a week 1 upset over the potentially fraudulent chargers were who we thought they were against the cream of the nfc west crop in the seahawks the 49ers pose a similar problem to arizona as the hawks did and with brock purdy in the zone the result should be similar expect san francisco to control sunday s game from the jump but just miss out on winning their straight game by at least 20 points thanks to garbage time heroics by trey mcbride and michael wilson why brooke picked the vikings there s early concern around zac robinson s offense in tampa my colleague nick shook s assessment of baker mayfield under his nth oc said it all the veteran qb is uncomfortable in this scheme at this juncture having to right the ship against a blitz happy vikings defense feels like an uphill climb despite mayfield performing well in such situations of late when blitzed this season he has a 68 8 success rate the second highest among qualified qbs per ngs that s a big jump up from his 39 3 mark in 2025 the third lowest if baker can navigate brian flores ferocious front deciphering when the no nonsense dc is sending the house or dropping guys into coverage the bucs should stay competitive i would have argued that tampa has the upper hand if carson wentz were starting but praise jesus we don t have to watch that stuck in the mud quarterback this week with kyler murray set to return we should finally get a better idea of what kevin o connell s offense looks like at close to full strength that ll be especially true if todd bowles defense continues to underperform cleveland s deshaun watson had his best outing in years against the bucs last week and to make matters worse first round edge rusherrueben bain s status is uncertain these teams are trending in opposite directions heading into this nfc clash why bobby picked the saints raiders saints might be the most underrated matchup on the week 3 docket new orleans an overtime two point conversion away from being 2 0 hosts a las vegas squad that remains unbeaten heading into late september the raiders have been playing winning football and doing so without tight end brock bowers who is expected to return from a knee injury sunday but it does come off as more of a mirage than what the saints have been doing while kirk cousins is tied for the nfl lead with six touchdown passes and the defense ranks fifth in points allowed with a league best 45 6 pressure percentage per pro football reference such success has so far come against the rebuilding dolphins and a chargers team in a tailspin even with the loss against the lions new orleans boasts the more impressive resume following its comeback victory over the ravens tyler shough has exhibited an excellent rapport with his top three pass catchers chris olave devaughn vele and juwan johnson he also appears to have the clutch gene after storming back from 21 down to force detroit to overtime and overcoming an 8 point fourth quarter deficit in the win over baltimore if the saints can keep shough comfortable against maxx crosby and co admittedly a big if with left tackle kelvin banks ankle out indefinitely the second year quarterback can be trusted to deliver again in new orleans 2026 home opener why jeremy picked the cowboys how do you say points in portuguese two of the league s most exciting offenses have the potential to produce a classico at the maracana on sunday in only its second international game dallas is looking to export its week 2 bounce back performance over the equator with possession dak prescott s attack proved what it s capable of against washington after their snf snoozer lamar jackson derrick henry and friends will hope to play keep away from dallas as the giants did in week 1 but if zay flowers hamstring misses a second straight game baltimore s aerial attack could be neutered again against a cowboys defense that hasn t found its footing yet under new coordinator christian parker as long as both teams actually have proper footing on the brazilian turf they should tear up and down the field but it ll be dak and dallas with more points in the end if the ravens had trouble with chris olave down the stretch in week 2 just think of the problems they ll encounter covering two olaves in ceedee lamb and george pickens in week 3 why gennaro picked the rams the super bowl lx matchup that wasn t eight months ago the rams and broncos suffered narrow defeats on championship sunday leaving both painfully short of the lombardi trophy game then they opened this season by hitting the road and humiliating themselves on national television both returned to form at home in week 2 though setting up a compelling clash worthy of the sunday night stage showcasing a pair of super bowl winning head coaches and two of the league s most well rounded rosters this game doesn t lack for star power and yet i see its outcome hinging on the rams meat and potatoes kyren williams and blake corum with eerily similar frames games and jersey numbers 23 and 24 l a s two backs are difficult to tell apart and so is their robust ground production through two games williams 23 rushes for 126 yards 5 5 per attempt and a touchdown corum 22 rushes for 133 yards 6 0 per attempt i see los angeles blue collar backfield playing a leading role in this prime time tilt denver cleaned up its tackling last week after an embarrassing display against kansas city s kenneth walker but i still think this front s susceptible to the run free agent departure john franklin myers got 63 million for a reason monday sept 28 why dan picked the eagles questions about the bears quarterback situation linger over what had previously looked like a juicy matchup bathed in prime time allure caleb williams is dealing with the hamstring injury he suffered last week and his backup tyson bagent is in the concussion protocol which means 38 year old third stringer case keenum is in line to start for chicago on monday night if williams and bagent can t go keenum hasn t played in a regular season game since 2023 when he threw one touchdown pass and three interceptions in two starts for the texans it s not hard to envision philadelphia defensive coordinator vic fangio rubbing his hands together in glee at his good fortune potentially missing out on having to game plan against one of the league s most dynamic young qbs and his capable backup the eagles have the lowest point differential 6 of any 2 0 team and struggled to put away the titans who haven t been competitive in years so while they might not be firing on all cylinders it will take an even larger letdown than the team s performance on black friday last year when the bears ran wild over philly to open the door for keenum to pull off the upset it looks like we re about to find out if ben johnson can perform miracles thursday s game why brooke picked the packers the packers lucky to eke out a victory in new york to avoid falling to 0 2 finally return to beloved lambeau field where they have won each of their last 13 home openers i have concerns about jordan love s o line which just lost starting right tackle zach bako bewele for the season and has others banged up og aaron banks ot anthony belton and backup ol donovan jennings love has already taken seven sacks tied for third most faced the fifth highest pressure rate in the nfl this season 42 3 and is tied for the most unblocked pressures faced 12 per nfl pro how matt lafleur game plans for his shorthanded offense against a falcons defense that ranks first against the run ninth on third down and in the red zone and has generated pressure on 41 5 percent on dropbacks seventh in the nfl per next gen stats could tell part of thursday night s story not having cb a j terrell hurts atlanta s chances of slowing christian watson and matthew golden but having michael penix under center should be a boon for that team even if he s still knocking off the rust this should look like a more competent unit one that s better suited to get bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts more involved these are two flawed teams and though i think we ll see an improved falcons outfit green bay has a much needed home field edge and a defense that s playing with confidence with budding star lukas van ness at the forefront clean up the penalties and this could be a turning point for the pack visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (glute) off injury report, to start Sunday vs. Commanders
news_mentions.description: Sam Darnold’s returning to the fold for the reigning Super Bowl champions. Darnold has no injury designation and will start for the Seahawks against the Commanders on Sunday after missing Week 2 with a glute injury.
news_mentions.body_text: sam darnold is returning to the fold for the reigning super bowl champions darnold has no injury designation and will start for the seattle seahawks against the washington commanders on sunday after missing week 2 with a glute injury injured in his team s season opening win over the new england patriots darnold is back pushing backup drew lock who performed admirably in the starter s stead back to the sideline darnold had returned to practice this week and was trending in the right way going from a limited participant on wednesday to fully practicing thursday coach mike macdonald said he d make the call about darnold s availability by friday and the call was a positive one darnold went 1 of 2 for 13 yards before being injured on the first drive of the seahawks season opener an eventual 13 10 win over the new england patriots in a super bowl rematch initially believed to have been a hip injury it was a glute ailment that would sideline darnold with an undefined timetable darnold missed the squad s week 2 win over the arizona cardinals with lock filling in and throwing three touchdown passes all to jaxon smith njigba in darnold s 2025 campaign his first for seattle he went to his second pro bowl in a row and helped the seahawks to a 14 3 regular season ahead of their super bowl triumph he completed 67 7 of his passes for 4 048 yards 25 touchdowns and 14 interceptions after a brief scare in the season opener and a missed week 2 darnold will re start his 2026 season on sunday against the commanders

news_mentions.headline: Niners DE Nick Bosa expected to miss multiple weeks with calf injury
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers DE Nick Bosa is expected to miss multiple weeks after suffering a calf injury in practice this week, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: nick bosa s 2026 season has encountered another interruption the 49ers edge rusher suffered a calf injury during practice this week and is expected to miss multiple weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported on friday it remains to be seen if he will be placed on injured reserve rapoport and schefter added coach kyle shanahan confirmed later friday that bosa hurt his calf ahead of thursday s practice and will be out a few weeks but will return this season bosa s 2025 season ended before it reached october when he suffered an acl injury that required season ending surgery in late september placing him on a long road back to the field in 2026 that journey appeared to be complete when training camp began but irritation and swelling in the same knee forced him to miss time during preseason preparations fortunately bosa was able to return in time for week 1 on a limited basis playing on a pitch count over the first two games in order to help him acclimate without pushing his knee too quickly his appearance on the team s injury report this week with knee and rest specifications was not surprising the addition of the calf ailment however became the latest blow to the 49ers banged up defensive front san francisco lost alfred collins to a torn patellar tendon and sam okuayinonu to a broken foot in the first two weeks of the regular season added defensive tackle cj west to injured reserve this week and were already entering this season without edge mykel williams who is also returning from a torn acl suffered in 2025 bosa was one of the last and best men standing along this front for the next few weeks san francisco will have to find a way to manage edge romello height won t participate in sunday s game against arizona but veterans ogbo okoronkwo and keion white are available to play but as was the case in 2025 the 49ers are once again incredibly thin defensively and are already determining who will or won t land on ir with the chance to return week 3 is simply too early for these challenges the 49ers will hope bosa can make a quick recovery

news_mentions.headline: Jayden Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on IR; Commanders GM says surgery 'not on the table'
news_mentions.description: Washington Commanders general manager Adam Peters took an optimistic stance on Jayden Daniels’ recovery from his latest elbow injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the commanders took an optimistic stance friday on jayden daniels recovery from his latest elbow injury as of right now surgery is not on the table and we haven t discussed injured reserve general manager adam peters said friday morning on the sports junkies on 106 7 the fan radio so it s just a matter of how we re going to get him back on the field that s still to be determined the most notable part of peters comment was that washington doesn t view ir as an option right now meaning the club expects the quarterback back sooner than a four week absence that would be required if he goes on ir coach dan quinn confirmed later friday that daniels will not be placed on ir as peters indicated the former offensive rookie of the year is considered week to week after undergoing imaging and consulting with multiple specialists about the injury to gain clarity on the extent of his absence like most things when you want to wait it out you go through the what ifs in your head and sometimes those are worse than the actual news quinn said what a great bit of news for him and for us daniels went down at the end of the first half of sunday s loss to dallas after a lineman stepped on him the qb tried to brace his fall with his non throwing arm which bent awkwardly daniels was later diagnosed with a dislocated elbow last year daniels season was also knocked off kilter and eventually ended by injuries to the same elbow peters comments don t provide a clear timeline for daniels returning to the field quinn said on monday that the expectation is marcus mariota will start sunday against seattle however with daniels not expected to land on ir there is a shot the qb returns in the next few weeks washington plays indianapolis in london in week 4 hosts the new york giants in week 5 and travels to san francisco to face the 49ers in prime time in week 6 before a bye

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Bengals backup Joe Flacco doesn't expect trade to Giants after Jaxson Dart injury: 'Not true'
news_mentions.description: Bengals backup Joe Flacco’s ties to Giants coach John Harbaugh make the 41-year-old an interesting trade target. However, Flacco doesn’t plan on leaving the Queen City.
news_mentions.body_text: with jaxson dart out for the season and jameis winston struggling in his stead the rumor mill has churned out potential trade options for the new york giants should winston continue to look like a player who spent his summer on the world cup tour cincinnati bengals backup joe flacco s ties to john harbaugh from their time in baltimore make the 41 year old an interesting target however flacco doesn t plan on leaving the queen city it s obviously not real and not true flacco told kelsey conway of the cincinnati enquirer about trade rumors but it was good enough to get people like certain friends of mine to get them to text me hey i ll see you in new york i was like no guys you won t that s not true given joe burrow s injury history it makes little to no sense for the bengals to trade flacco even with a veteran like josh johnson on the practice squad if burrow goes down for a spell flacco is the best option to keep things afloat i just get a kick out of it he said i haven t really given it too much thought at this point last year flacco wasn t aware he was being traded from cleveland to cincinnati so anything can happen but there is minuscule incentive for the bengals to trade their top backup or the giants to part with an asset for a 41 year old who isn t going to change their season long trajectory regardless of his relationship with the head coach in these cases it s not up to me flacco said i m on the cincinnati bengals and because of that that s my focus being here doing the things that i need to do to get better each day while i m here make sure i m absorbing the game plan and all of those things i get a little bit of a kick out of it but it s kind out of my hands i m a cincinnati bengal and i m doing everything i can to get ready for the pittsburgh steelers the giants recently gave winston an extension he ll get a chance to run the offense before new york hits the panic button if winston is so awful that big blue is desperate for qb help the season is probably lost anyway backups with experience like flacco will always be named as potential candidates whenever a starter goes down just because there are speculative rumors doesn t mean a trade makes sense for either party

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs want to lighten Kenneth Walker's workload after 56 touches in two games
news_mentions.description: Kenneth Walker III has rejuvenated the Kansas City offense, bringing a tackle-breaking ground element that had been missing. The Chiefs, however, know they mustn’t grind the RB into the ground.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker has rejuvenated the kansas city chiefs offense bringing a tackle breaking ground element that had been missing the chiefs however know they mustn t grind the rb into the ground coach andy reid said this week the club would like to reduce walker s workload a little bit heading into week 3 walker led the nfl with 290 rushing yards and 369 scrimmage yards in 2026 two touchdowns after thursday night football bijan robinson now leads with 349 and 467 respectively walker s rushing yard tally marks the most by any nfl player through two weeks since c j spiller in 2012 292 walker is on pace for 2 465 rush yards which would be an nfl record by 360 yards he s also tied with jahmyr gibbs with 56 scrimmage touches we re lucky to have him running backs coach demarco murray said thursday via espn he s a great leader and he s done a great job for us he s prepared himself for this workload since the spring coach reid puts a great training camp together and the long drive drill is legendary around here walker likes the ball a lot walker s 369 scrimmage yards are the second most by a player in his first two games with a team in the super bowl era only billy sims had more with the lions the back has forced 29 missed tackles in 2026 per next gen stats most through two weeks in ngs era the key is balance and ensuring walker who never played a full 17 game slate before last season remains healthy to that end the chiefs plan to give rookie emmett johnson who has also flashed tackle breaking acumen more run we just want to continue to make sure we re bringing our rookies along the right way offensive coordinator eric bieniemy said thursday emmett s role is to continue to grow as the season progresses what you don t want to do when you re raising some of these young players is put them in a situation where it could be detrimental to them you want them feeling free and confident through two games johnson has generated 10 rushes for 39 yards and four catches for 64 yards 103 scrimmage yards the plan is to get the rookie more carries starting with sunday s game against the miami dolphins i want kenneth to get into a groove and it s hard to kind of take him out murray said but emmett s done a great job and he s still learning he ll continue to get more opportunities i ve just got to pull the trigger and get no 9 walker out of there and put no 10 johnson in there

news_mentions.headline: Packers coach Matt LaFleur: 'Butt-whooping' from Falcons was 'humbling'
news_mentions.description: The Green Bay Packers got bullied by a previously 0-2 Atlanta Falcons squad, 35-14, as the Lambeau Field fans rained down boos.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay is no stranger to dense flurries usually they don t come in september and usually those squalls aren t of the vociferous nature from locals fed up with the football team thursday night packers fans showered their club with boos during an embarrassing 35 14 loss to the atlanta falcons well that was a humbling night coach matt lafleur said certainly i don t think anybody is pleased about this and you know we ve got a couple extra days here and everybody s got to take a long hard look at themselves and we ve got to find solutions and just come back ready to work but it certainly was a tough night tough doesn t begin to describe the ugly watch as the packers gave up 27 unanswered points at one point lafleur s offense couldn t move the ball the defense couldn t stop bijan robinson or drake london green bay made a previously 0 2 falcons squad look like the 89 niners it was a butt whooping lafleur noted i m not going to put it on one thing certainly we definitely have to respond better but that was at least three quarters of butt whooping right there atlanta lost 34 3 at home to the carolina panthers on sunday was the return of michael penix worth a 52 point swing the quarterback certainly got kevin stefanski s offense motoring without the clutch crippling miscues from qb3 and qb4 who played in the first two games thursday s tilt however said much more about the packers than the falcons lafleur s squad is a mismanaged game by jets coach aaron glenn from starting 0 3 green bay has lost two of its first three games by at least 17 points in 2026 it is the first time the packers have lost multiple games by 17 points in an entire season since 2017 their 21 point loss in week 3 versus the falcons is their largest home loss in prime time since week 5 2004 against steve mcnair and the titans lost 48 27 their 35 point differential in 2026 is their worst through three games since 1988 the defense has struggled to get stops on thursday the packers missed a trove of tackles and the back end got burned when they stepped up to try to slow robinson more concerning is an offense playing as if it s in quicksand the shuffled offensive line is a mess it can t pass block or open holes the running game is cripplingly bad with rbs who miss holes rarely break tackles or try to bounce everything outside and jordan love has been an inaccurate disaster whether the pressure has gotten to the qb who entered his fourth year as a starter or he s simply panicking love s play has been dismal through three games love was pressured 23 times 41 8 pressure rate in week 3 against the falcons completing eight of 21 pass attempts for 71 yards and one interception to start the season love has been pressured on 42 1 of his dropbacks completing just 18 passes under pressure for 47 yards and two interceptions the lack of a rushing attack has been a problem it was a surprise during the offseason that green bay didn t do more to bolster the rb room given josh jacobs legal quandary with the veteran on the commissioner s exempt list that problem has been exacerbated the packers rushed for 17 total yards on nine carries on thursday the falcons had three runs of at least 16 yards i think we ve got to continue to work with these guys and try to figure out what we do well because right now i don t know what we re doing well offensively lafleur admitted it was obvious to the home fans who booed the packers play relentlessly tight end tucker kraft who suffered several drops took issue with the green bay fanatics voicing their negative opinion that s pretty tough like everyone pictures lambeau field and not boos kraft said via matt schneidman of the athletic i don t picture boos i picture my home stadium that s tough it s pretty disappointing especially for a home opener it s pretty disappointing it s not going to help us win like i don t know what people think that s going to rally us or something like that but that s we re grown men we re mentally strong enough capable enough to get back on the field and play ball but it d probably much easier with the 70 000 people behind us rather than opposing us the loyalty of packers fans is unquestioned if they re booing it s because the product is not up to the level of excellence the organization has established blind support is for sheep the extra few days before the packers take the field again in tampa bay are as pivotal a stretch as lafleur has faced in his tenure in green bay

news_mentions.headline: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. moves on from contract talks, offers no firm timeline for return
news_mentions.description: Joey Porter Jr. hasn't yet suited up for the Steelers this season but has attracted plenty of attention for his absence.
news_mentions.body_text: joey porter has not yet suited up for the steelers this season but has attracted plenty of attention for his absence he finally addressed the contract and health related matter thursday downplaying the drama that has followed him since the start of training camp in short he s working his way back to the field and is no longer concerned with the financial standoff that lurked beneath his injury report status it didn t get done it didn t happen porter said of his desired contract extension adding he did not request a trade that s really just old news for me now it s mainly just focus on what i ve got ahead of me and just really getting back to 100 porter is not currently at 100 percent but is gradually improving from a persistent back injury that sidelined him for all of training camp he s also still trying to work his way into football shape after spending the summer preparatory period on the physically unable to perform list this isn t a matter of simply taking a few days off to get right it s a complex multi faceted situation that should benefit from a longer timeline to return even if that clashes with the win now environment that is the nfl regular season it s both porter who was limited again in thursday s practice said of his injury and his conditioning my back has its moments where it flares up here and there we re still just trying to get my conditioning down to me just being out there as much as possible it s really just both porter said he ll definitely play at some point this season but wasn t willing to commit or comment on an outlook beyond thursday he did toss in some good news though his absence hasn t strained his relationship with his teammates no i love all my guys and my guys love me too porter said so they re here for me and i m there for them i m just trying to be a good motivator to all the young guys and even the o g s in here those teammates will continue to carry on without him hopefully it won t be too long before he rejoins them porter s steelers 1 1 host the rival bengals 2 0 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett defends Marvin Harrison Jr. amid criticism of slow start
news_mentions.description: Cardinals WR Marvin Harrison has just one catch through two games to start the season. QB Jacoby Brissett defended the wideout when talking to reporters on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: arizona cardinals wide receiver marvin harrison is now in year three of his nfl career and is still hearing the same questions why aren t you more involved in the offense where are the big plays we were promised through two games this season harrison has seen just four targets he s caught one a fantastic snag down the sideline in week 1 for 33 yards production that doesn t match his status as the no 4 overall pick in the 2024 draft pressed for answers after seeing just one target in arizona s lopsided week 2 loss to seattle harrison explained it as a matter of circumstance it s definitely a combination of a lot of things harrison told reporters on wednesday via espn for my route tree getting down the field you need a lot of things to go right you need the right coverage you need protection to hold up you need me to run a great route you need obviously jacoby brissett to make the right pass and make the right read so i feel like it s never one person s fault for anybody s success or lack thereof really so i think it s always a combination of a bunch of things and whether that s a lack of success or success in general it doesn t help that despite spotty at best production harrison is seen as arizona s most dangerous threat in the cardinals receiving corps which will draw additional attention from opposing defenses in arizona s week 1 win over the chargers los angeles only left him on an island in single coverage on seven of the 33 routes he ran he won his only press man matchup a situation in which his size and route running gives him an advantage on the sideline grab his lone contribution to arizona s season opening highlight reel brissett meanwhile leaned heavily on tight end trey mcbride in both games capitalizing on coverage mismatches to the tune of nine completions for 95 yards and a touchdown in week 1 in their low output week 2 contest mcbride was arizona s passing offense logging the most targets 10 and catches 8 for 41 yards and his second touchdown of the season it s clear brissett prefers the playmaking tight end as a reliable target but harrison still looms as a big play threat if given the opportunities which were sparse in their 31 7 loss to the defensively driven reigning champions this past sunday pretty much that simple harrison said seattle s a really good defense and you don t want to give a lot of teams especially a rival team a lot of credit but when you just look across the league they re far beyond above everybody else especially on the defensive side of the football so things like that happen if it were the first slow start for harrison folks might give him grace but through two seasons and the first two weeks of 2026 harrison s productivity hasn t come close to matching his expectations previous struggles were partially pinned on arizona s instability at quarterback with kyler murray s health challenges limiting his availability and hindering their chances of establishing a rapport defensive minded coach jonathan gannon s presence also gave cardinals an easy excuse now though the underwhelming performances are rising to a concerning level coach mike lafleur brings the offensive expertise for which cardinals fans previously yearned yet the initial returns remain the same for harrison he hears the criticism fortunately he also has the support of his quarterback is some of the noise justified brissett said i don t think so personally we just signed mike wilson for 25 million and nobody said anything about him having two catches i think people try to find somewhere to make something out of nothing the only thing you can do is just go out there and just continue to get better as a teammate of him and him as an individual and i think that s what we re doing harrison is no stranger to the spotlight he arrived at ohio state as a top recruit succeeded stars garrett wilson chris olave and jaxon smith njigba the 2025 nfl offensive player of the year in columbus and knew he d be a top pick in the 2024 nfl draft he just hasn t delivered on those expectations yet no he said when asked if he was surprised by the public reaction to his slow start i mean i understand who i am and what i was expected to do when i got drafted here and all the expectations that were put on me and i think people want certain production so when that s not happening everybody s going to ask questions or figure out why is that the reason and so i wouldn t say i m surprised by anything that s talked about me anyway fortunately he still has 15 more games this season to prove them wrong

news_mentions.headline: Chargers QB Justin Herbert rejects leadership concerns: 'I trust those guys in that locker room'
news_mentions.description: When a team starts 0-2, it’s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback. That’s what’s happening in Los Angeles, where Justin Herbert's winless Chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned.
news_mentions.body_text: when a team starts 0 2 it s easy to blindly pin blame on the quarterback that s what s happening in los angeles where the winless chargers are fighting off talk of catastrophe and their leadership is being questioned that specific query is what set off justin herbert on wednesday i think that happens regardless i think our team is so close and so i don t think there s a lack of vocal leadership at all an especially stern herbert said when asked if the team lacked a vocal leader so i think i m going to stop you right there and say that it s very present we ve got great leadership on this team i trust those guys in that locker room and so i don t think anyone is panicked or worried because that s not going to do us any good it s moving on to the next play and understanding we re close we ve made mistakes how do we fix them how do we move on mistakes have been plentiful for the chargers who have committed 15 accepted penalties for 109 yards and given away possession five times in two games those numbers don t account for the dropped passes either like the sharp throw from herbert that tight end david njoku bobbled into the hands of las vegas raiders cornerback hezekiah masses in week 2 simply the chargers have been an operational mess through two weeks herbert has had his positive moments but he too has made mistakes unnecessarily forcing passes in winnable games that have resulted in tide turning interceptions the upgraded offense that was supposed to come with the arrival of coordinator mike mcdaniel has failed to materialize and los angeles has scored just 28 points in two games i think anytime you learn a new offense um you re gonna have times where you re gonna just want to do your best and make sure that you re doing everything you can to be at your best herbert said so no i think every nfl offense is a complicated one but i think it s just on us to be studying our stuff making sure that we re ready to go the last line in herbert s response is intriguing if not illuminating the chargers have appeared anything but prepared to start this season getting outplayed and outcoached by an underdog arizona cardinals team that rolled into sofi stadium in week 1 and gleefully punched the bolts in the mouth the raiders enjoyed similar success in week 2 capitalizing on busted coverages poor discipline and even worse execution that made them look like the superior team too it s incredibly far from the standard coach jim harbaugh has set in los angeles since he arrived in 2024 and with the chargers schedule significantly increasing in difficulty starting in week 3 the pressure is on i think it s just about us being at our best learning and continuing to get better doing what we re coached to to be at our best herbert said they ll need to be at their peak sunday when they head to buffalo to face the red hot bills otherwise herbert will field more of the same frustrating questions again next week

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
news_mentions.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can with what you have right now where you re at winston and the giants 1 1 host the titans 0 2 on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Bills QB Josh Allen, 49ers QB Brock Purdy highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: San Francisco signal-caller Brock Purdy and Buffalo quarterback Josh Allen were among the half-dozen players lauded Wednesday for their Week 2 heroics.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 2 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week allen has been a scoring machine so far this season and on thursday he opened up the new highmark stadium with a resounding five touchdown performance in the bills 41 31 victory over the lions through the air allen had three touchdowns and 248 yards while he had 69 yards and two more tds on the ground through two games allen has piled up five passing tds and four scores on the ground incredibly this is allen s 19th afc player of the week honor which is tied for 14th all time and trails only aaron rodgers 27 among active players nfc offensive player of the week pinpoint accuracy and stellar numbers have marked purdy s performance over two games this season in sunday s 35 13 thrashing of the miami dolphins purdy was 20 of 22 90 9 for 287 passing yards and two touchdowns so far he leads the nfl with an 80 4 completion percentage and has thrown for five tds and 492 yards the nfc west is loaded with talent and had a string of stellar week 2 showings from the rams matthew stafford 327 passing yards four td passes and davante adams eight receptions for 195 yards two tds along with the seahawks jaxon smith njigba nine catches for 155 yards three tds but it was the efficiency of purdy that defensed a tackle for loss and two interceptions masses hauled in his first career interception off a bobbled ball in the first quarter before sealing the win late in the fourth quarter thanks to his second pick nfc defensive player of the week lloyd was a monster on sunday with the stats to prove it after the panthers 34 3 trouncing of the atlanta falcons the one time pro bowler racked up nine
