news_mentions.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: Los Angeles Rams training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Grodon provides a refresher on the Los Angeles Rams' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 3 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Will the Lamar Jackson's Ravens or Dak Prescott's Cowboys prevail in Brazil? Who takes a compelling Sunday night clash between the Rams and Broncos? Which 0-2 teams could get in the win column? Check out the Week 3 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 3 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 24 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 27 why bobby picked the bills fool me once shame on you fool me twice shame on me i will not be picking the chargers for a third straight week nor am i likely to throw my support behind them very much at all in the coming months considering the juggernauts lined up to face them first up on that list the bills who look to be the cream of the afc crop in the early goings of this season josh allen is on fire having already accounted for nine touchdowns five passing four rushing while leading buffalo to 36 or more points in each of the team s first two games while there are some pressing questions about the bills defense nothing has come easy to the chargers in mike mcdaniel s new scheme justin herbert looks uncomfortable his pass catchers have been affected by multiple big drops and injuries and lead back omarion hampton has lost a fumble in both games there s nothing to suggest los angeles can string together enough scoring drives to keep up with buffalo s mighty offense look for the bills to move to 3 0 in dominating fashion why bobby picked the panthers cleveland s upset victory over the buccaneers felt more like tampa bay continuing to be the team that fell on its face throughout the end of last season than a sign the browns will stick it to another nfc south opponent lest that be misconstrued as a browns is the browns take cleveland played well and fought hard for its win deshaun watson was as precise as he s been in years rookie denzel boston looks like a stud and the browns defense was the far more composed side during the game s final two minutes in the aftermath of a 132 minute weather delay the panthers just happen to be playing better ball than both the bucs and the browns bryce young is off to the best start of his career buoyed by the budding wide receiver duo of tetairoa mcmillan and jalen coker he s averaged 324 passing yards through two games with three touchdown passes in each contest it s not out of the question he keeps it going against a cleveland defense still navigating the early days of the post myles garrett era the wild card remains the panthers defensive jekyll and hyde act to start the season are they the closer to the group that gave up 59 points to an explosive bears team in the opener or the unit that dominated a woeful falcons squad while allowing just 3 points even if it s more the former dave canales offense should be able to do enough for a victory why jeremy picked the lions aaron glenn s return to detroit where he was dan campbell s defensive coordinator for four seasons will be the ultimate test for his jets defense s early turnaround after games against the titans and packers offenses asterisk needed gang green s defense which received an influx of veteran talent in the offseason ranks in the top three in yards per game 197 0 first yards per play 4 0 third and third down conversion rate 23 8 second new york will be without a few injured vets in the motor city but should get back joseph ossai for sunday s game whether glenn s jets feast depends on which lions team shows up detroit has a talent advantage on offense but has yet to play a complete game this season nearly blowing week 1 against new orleans forgetting to show up until the second half of the bills loss the lions defense is banged up but so is new york s receiving corps detroit s best bet sunday is getting to geno smith with aidan hutchinson and co the qb hasn t turned the ball over yet but he s faced a 43 4 pressure rate second in the nfl only to the injured jayden daniels and the veteran is due despite his claims otherwise as week 2 proved the jets still need to learn how to win new york is close but the lesson won t come this week against a tested lions team why gennaro picked the texans is this an elimination game in september as the only week 3 matchup between winless teams this afc south showdown screams desperation since 1990 just 2 9 percent of squads that lost their first three games went on to make the playoffs we re talkin five out of 171 people of course last year s texans were one of those five and while houston s hyped defense looked shockingly porous against josh allen s bills in week 1 the unit largely stifled joe burrow and the bengals last sunday i anticipate continued success against a one dimensional colts offense jonathan taylor s a stud no doubt but he has to be a one man army with daniel jones still seemingly working his way back from last december s achilles tear add in the fact that indianapolis 114 million field stretcher just hit injured reserve and houston can commit additional resources to stopping the colts bell cow back meanwhile indy s defense hasn t been able to stop anyone giving up the second most yards ever in the first two weeks of a season 1 2016 raiders 1 035 yards allowed 2 2026 colts 1 029 t 3 1967 falcons 1 025 t 3 2017 saints 1 025 oddly enough the two bookends on that list the 2016 raiders and 2017 saints both made the playoffs with double digit wins maybe the colts have everyone right where they want them or maybe they re doomed to suffer a sixth straight loss to c j stroud and co why dan picked the jaguars there will be no sneaking up on anyone for this season s jaguars and patriots not after they both surprised in 2025 sunday s meeting is an opportunity to establish which squad has more staying power in the afc s upper ranks and the trenches might dictate which team has the edge jacksonville needs better play from the offensive line especially on the interior if it s going to bounce back from blowing a lead against denver new england has a duo that can exploit a team s weakness up the middle with milton williams and christian barmore at defensive tackle one thing that could work in the jags favor is the pats ailing health new england has taken hits to the league s no 1 scoring defense edge rusher dre mont jones and safety craig woodson missed wednesday s practice with shoulder issues and lost rg mike onwenu ankle to injured reserve i m leaning ever so slightly toward the home team in what figures to be a highly entertaining battle why gennaro picked the chiefs two weeks ago we didn t really know what to expect from kansas city the chiefs were coming off their first losing campaign under andy reid while patrick mahomes was returning from knee surgery two games into the season it feels like the team and the quarterback are back whole different story in miami we all knew the 2026 dolphins would be bad that s what happens when a new regime takes the roster down to the studs and carries a whopping 183 7 million in dead money but this feels like a dead team walking what does miami do well without any established firepower beyond rb de von achane the offense can t sustain drives the defense had no answer for raiders rb ashton jeanty in week 1 and nearly allowed a perfect game from 49ers qb brock purdy in week 2 so the better question might be what does miami do this is a rebuilding team without an identity that doesn t play well against a resurgent power with hall of fame leadership yes this is miami s home opener and kansas city s first road game no i don t think that completely flips the script in the fins favor why gennaro picked the titans both teams are coming off a loss but their vibes couldn t be more different tennessee gave philadelphia all it could handle in a 24 20 defeat instilling confidence in the young titans that they can compete with real super bowl contenders a true moral victory new york on the other hand suffered extreme agony in defeat the giants not only lost to the rams by 22 points but they lost jaxson dart to knee surgery john harbaugh had a thousand yard stare after the second year quarterback went down on monday night and now he has to steer the ship without his best defensive player too as brian burns is reportedly set to miss time with an ankle injury remember all that hope following new york s season opening win over dallas consider it dashed the g men just experienced a devastating gut punch and i think the effects carry over into sunday s game against a suddenly frisky foe you know tennessee oc brian daboll would love to knock off the team that fired him last november and while head coach robert saleh failed to exact his revenge on the jets in week 1 he d undoubtedly enjoy notching his first win as titans head coach in his old home of metlife stadium why brooke picked the bengals cincinnati is seeing the fruits of its offseason labor defensively and perhaps no player has been more influential to his new team than dt dexter lawrence through two weeks according to ngs with lawrence on the field the defense has generated a 45 2 pressure rate allowed 2 9 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 58 3 of carries without him on the field cincy has generated a 35 1 pressure rate allowed 5 6 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 21 4 of carries sexy dexy s influence bodes well for a bengals team heading into a hostile road environment to face an offense in which the qb and play caller don t appear to be on the same page even if pittsburgh gets michael pittman foot back this unit doesn t strike fear in anyone right now and isn t likely to keep up with joe burrow ja 39 marr chase and the bengals oh so explosive offense there s a lot of pressure on the steelers eighth ranked overall and scoring defense to make plays it ll make its fair share but ultimately it won t be enough one nfl pro insight matchup to watch bengals lt orlando brown vs steelers olb alex highsmith brown has allowed a pressure on 13 of his pass blocks against the steelers in 13 career games including the postseason the highest rate he has allowed against any opponent min 100 pass blocks that rate jumps to 15 1 if you limit it to browns time with the bengals six games against pittsburgh meanwhile highsmith has generated 24 pressures against brown including 16 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds the fourth most quick pressures by any pass rusher against a single blocker since 2018 nick herbig has added 13 pressures and three sacks on 78 matchups against brown why dan picked the seahawks just when it seemed like the commanders were starting to cook on offense they are forced once again to face life without jayden daniels who has now had more dislocations of his left elbow than any person should ever have to experience unfortunately for backup qb marcus mariota his return to a starting role coincides with a visit from arguably the league s most ferocious defense the 2026 seahawks are one of just five defenses since 2010 to allow fewer than 20 points and fewer than four yards per play over their first two games of a season per nfl research each of the previous four teams to do so won 11 or more games it s true that seattle might be trotting out its own backup qb for the second week in a row but drew lock has proven a tremendous fill in for sam darnold editor s update on friday seahawks coach mike macdonald announced that sam darnold is returning to the starting lineup on sunday there s always the threat of a west coast team being discombobulated by a cross country trip but i m not paying it any mind in this case the seahawks are 7 0 in road games that kicked off at 1 p m et under head coach mike macdonald why jeremy picked the 49ers no team is having an easier start to the season than san francisco blowout victories over the jet lagged rams and doe eyed dolphins have the 49ers playing out of this world even when they re on the other side of it in come the cardinals who after a week 1 upset over the potentially fraudulent chargers were who we thought they were against the cream of the nfc west crop in the seahawks the 49ers pose a similar problem to arizona as the hawks did and with brock purdy in the zone the result should be similar expect san francisco to control sunday s game from the jump but just miss out on winning their straight game by at least 20 points thanks to garbage time heroics by trey mcbride and michael wilson why brooke picked the vikings there s early concern around zac robinson s offense in tampa my colleague nick shook s assessment of baker mayfield under his nth oc said it all the veteran qb is uncomfortable in this scheme at this juncture having to right the ship against a blitz happy vikings defense feels like an uphill climb despite mayfield performing well in such situations of late when blitzed this season he has a 68 8 success rate the second highest among qualified qbs per ngs that s a big jump up from his 39 3 mark in 2025 the third lowest if baker can navigate brian flores ferocious front deciphering when the no nonsense dc is sending the house or dropping guys into coverage the bucs should stay competitive i would have argued that tampa has the upper hand if carson wentz were starting but praise jesus we don t have to watch that stuck in the mud quarterback this week with kyler murray set to return we should finally get a better idea of what kevin o connell s offense looks like at close to full strength that ll be especially true if todd bowles defense continues to underperform cleveland s deshaun watson had his best outing in years against the bucs last week and to make matters worse first round edge rusherrueben bain s status is uncertain these teams are trending in opposite directions heading into this nfc clash why bobby picked the saints raiders saints might be the most underrated matchup on the week 3 docket new orleans an overtime two point conversion away from being 2 0 hosts a las vegas squad that remains unbeaten heading into late september the raiders have been playing winning football and doing so without tight end brock bowers who is expected to return from a knee injury sunday but it does come off as more of a mirage than what the saints have been doing while kirk cousins is tied for the nfl lead with six touchdown passes and the defense ranks fifth in points allowed with a league best 45 6 pressure percentage per pro football reference such success has so far come against the rebuilding dolphins and a chargers team in a tailspin even with the loss against the lions new orleans boasts the more impressive resume following its comeback victory over the ravens tyler shough has exhibited an excellent rapport with his top three pass catchers chris olave devaughn vele and juwan johnson he also appears to have the clutch gene after storming back from 21 down to force detroit to overtime and overcoming an 8 point fourth quarter deficit in the win over baltimore if the saints can keep shough comfortable against maxx crosby and co admittedly a big if with left tackle kelvin banks ankle out indefinitely the second year quarterback can be trusted to deliver again in new orleans 2026 home opener why jeremy picked the cowboys how do you say points in portuguese two of the league s most exciting offenses have the potential to produce a classico at the maracana on sunday in only its second international game dallas is looking to export its week 2 bounce back performance over the equator with possession dak prescott s attack proved what it s capable of against washington after their snf snoozer lamar jackson derrick henry and friends will hope to play keep away from dallas as the giants did in week 1 but if zay flowers hamstring misses a second straight game baltimore s aerial attack could be neutered again against a cowboys defense that hasn t found its footing yet under new coordinator christian parker as long as both teams actually have proper footing on the brazilian turf they should tear up and down the field but it ll be dak and dallas with more points in the end if the ravens had trouble with chris olave down the stretch in week 2 just think of the problems they ll encounter covering two olaves in ceedee lamb and george pickens in week 3 why gennaro picked the rams the super bowl lx matchup that wasn t eight months ago the rams and broncos suffered narrow defeats on championship sunday leaving both painfully short of the lombardi trophy game then they opened this season by hitting the road and humiliating themselves on national television both returned to form at home in week 2 though setting up a compelling clash worthy of the sunday night stage showcasing a pair of super bowl winning head coaches and two of the league s most well rounded rosters this game doesn t lack for star power and yet i see its outcome hinging on the rams meat and potatoes kyren williams and blake corum with eerily similar frames games and jersey numbers 23 and 24 l a s two backs are difficult to tell apart and so is their robust ground production through two games williams 23 rushes for 126 yards 5 5 per attempt and a touchdown corum 22 rushes for 133 yards 6 0 per attempt i see los angeles blue collar backfield playing a leading role in this prime time tilt denver cleaned up its tackling last week after an embarrassing display against kansas city s kenneth walker but i still think this front s susceptible to the run free agent departure john franklin myers got 63 million for a reason monday sept 28 why dan picked the eagles questions about the bears quarterback situation linger over what had previously looked like a juicy matchup bathed in prime time allure caleb williams is dealing with the hamstring injury he suffered last week and his backup tyson bagent is in the concussion protocol which means 38 year old third stringer case keenum is in line to start for chicago on monday night if williams and bagent can t go keenum hasn t played in a regular season game since 2023 when he threw one touchdown pass and three interceptions in two starts for the texans it s not hard to envision philadelphia defensive coordinator vic fangio rubbing his hands together in glee at his good fortune potentially missing out on having to game plan against one of the league s most dynamic young qbs and his capable backup the eagles have the lowest point differential 6 of any 2 0 team and struggled to put away the titans who haven t been competitive in years so while they might not be firing on all cylinders it will take an even larger letdown than the team s performance on black friday last year when the bears ran wild over philly to open the door for keenum to pull off the upset it looks like we re about to find out if ben johnson can perform miracles thursday s game why brooke picked the packers the packers lucky to eke out a victory in new york to avoid falling to 0 2 finally return to beloved lambeau field where they have won each of their last 13 home openers i have concerns about jordan love s o line which just lost starting right tackle zach bako bewele for the season and has others banged up og aaron banks ot anthony belton and backup ol donovan jennings love has already taken seven sacks tied for third most faced the fifth highest pressure rate in the nfl this season 42 3 and is tied for the most unblocked pressures faced 12 per nfl pro how matt lafleur game plans for his shorthanded offense against a falcons defense that ranks first against the run ninth on third down and in the red zone and has generated pressure on 41 5 percent on dropbacks seventh in the nfl per next gen stats could tell part of thursday night s story not having cb a j terrell hurts atlanta s chances of slowing christian watson and matthew golden but having michael penix under center should be a boon for that team even if he s still knocking off the rust this should look like a more competent unit one that s better suited to get bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts more involved these are two flawed teams and though i think we ll see an improved falcons outfit green bay has a much needed home field edge and a defense that s playing with confidence with budding star lukas van ness at the forefront clean up the penalties and this could be a turning point for the pack visit news_mentions.headline: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? Plus, three disappointing units
news_mentions.description: Can anyone stop the Bills' offense? Block the Vikings' defense? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks provides game plans for two of the NFL's toughest assignments. Plus, three wildly disappointing units in the young season.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three units experiencing serious struggles in the young season but first a look at a prolific offense and a devastating defense the season is only a few weeks old but no units have shined brighter than the buffalo bills offense and minnesota vikings defense joe brady and brian flores have unlocked their jimmys and joes by cleverly deploying the x s and o s on the grassy chessboard with both teams sitting atop their respective divisions at 2 0 the rest of the league is trying to figure out how to slow down the bills explosive offense and block the vikings blitz happy defense after digging into the all 22 film on nfl pro here are three keys to tackling two of the league s toughest assignments in 2026 three keys to stopping the bills offense 1 play keep away reducing the number of possessions buffalo receives is the best way to neutralize one of the league s most explosive offenses josh allen and co cannot score if they don t have the ball so a ball control strategy designed to shrink the game is the no 1 objective for a team facing this juggernaut this season the bills are averaging just 28 44 in time of possession 24th in the nfl while running 60 5 offensive plays per game 15th but they lead the league in scoring 38 5 ppg and rank second in total offense 427 5 ypg given the bills explosive potential and efficient production opposing coaches should build game plans around a complementary football strategy that emphasizes a slower offensive pace from taking the play clock down to five seconds or fewer before snapping the ball to staying in bounds on perimeter runs every offensive player must understand the turtle approach being employed to keep buffalo s high powered offense on the sidelines by reducing total possessions and plays opponents can ramp up pressure on the bills offense to do more with less although the ultra efficient unit has set off fireworks with limited possessions thus far the slowdown strategy gives opponents a better chance to win with stops and turnovers which are at a higher premium in a low possession game 2 make josh allen win from the pocket the 2024 nfl mvp is one of the league s most dangerous playmakers having eclipsed 35 total touchdowns for six straight seasons in each of the past three campaigns the 6 foot 5 237 pounder has logged at least 25 passing tds and 12 rushing scores a feat no other quarterback has ever accomplished although he is an explosive pocket passer with exceptional range allen is an unstoppable force when he uses his athleticism and running skills to create big plays on the perimeter whether picking up first downs on designed quarterback runs or impromptu scrambles run around tosses the four time pro bowler terrorizes defenses when he flees the pocket to counter his big play potential defensive coordinators must implement a pass rush plan that has everyone rush to the depth of his drop in order to restrict escape lanes in the pocket additionally pass rushers must work together to create a coordinated mush rush as opposed to operating as independent contractors attacking no 17 with random 1 on 1 pass rush maneuvers defensive coordinators also need to account for allen s impact on designed quarterback runs particularly in goal line and short yardage situations the supersized playmaker has a knack for moving the chains and or finding the paint on quarterback powers following direct snaps or flash fakes in the backfield defensive play callers must assign a defender to the quarterback to prevent the bills from capitalizing on the plus one advantage created by a running qb finally the bills signal caller must be kept in check in the gotta have it moments when he is prone to leave the pocket while operating in playmaker mode allen has routinely relied on his improvisational skills on third down in the red zone and in two minute situations so defenders must be aware of his tendencies in those moments to minimize his impact while containing allen is easier said than done the most successful defenses against buffalo have made the superstar a one dimensional threat 3 take away the middle of the field the bills made a blockbuster trade in march to acquire a wr1 in dj moore but the team s dynamic tight end duo of dalton kincaid and dawson knox is the linchpin of the passing game kincaid in particular has emerged as buffalo s top pass catcher with his speed quickness and ball skills posing problems for linebackers and safeties matching up with him the 2023 first rounder leads the team in targets 14 receptions 12 and receiving yards 225 doing most of his damage on short and intermediate routes between the numbers in addition kincaid is a sneaky vertical threat who routinely cruises past defenders on seam routes since 2024 allen has totaled 11 completions for 253 yards and three touchdowns when targeting kincaid on open downfield throws 3 plus yards of target separation and 10 plus air yards per next gen stats given the playmaking tight end s impact opponents must shut down the middle of the field and force allen to find completions elsewhere by jamming the middle with a robber safety or utilizing bracket coverage with a linebacker and safety assigned to kincaid the defense can put the onus on moore and others to win their 1 on 1 matchups on the perimeter despite the fanfare around moore s arrival and his eye popping yards per catch average thus far 20 0 the bills inside out passing game is nearly impossible to stop when their no 1 tight end is getting loose over the middle by limiting kincaid s impact and forcing buffalo to rely on a complementary pass catcher to carry the aerial attack opponents can hope the tactics disrupt a well oiled machine that is already in midseason form three keys to surviving the vikings defense 1 crack the code vikings dc brian flores exotic pressures and unorthodox coverage patterns are masked by a clever series of pre snap disguises that befuddle quarterbacks at the line of scrimmage with the organized chaos creating hesitation and doubt for novice and experienced passers opposing coaching staffs should operate at a quicker pace to give their quarterbacks access to the offensive coordinator at the line of scrimmage communication devices shut off with 15 seconds left on the play clock and allow for double cadence calls qb barks out the signals and fakes a snap count before re assessing the defense and repeating the process with a different play call based on the defensive look those kinds of tactics force the vikings to reveal their plans while plenty of quarterbacks have attempted these techniques against flores aggressive approach the vikings snowflake game plans make it hard to predict how the defense will align after the snap as a zone blitz heavy outfit minnesota s d balances ultra aggressive six man hot pressures with three man rushes drop eight coverages consequently quarterbacks are lured into a high stakes guessing game that ultimately produces mistakes and turnovers against a unit that relies heavily on blitzes and chaos a quicker tempo produces more vanilla defensive looks due to communication and alignment assignment issues with so many tempo ploys available to offensive coordinators the best game plan should mix no huddle sugar huddle and fast break tactics that eliminate the time minnesota needs to run intricate pre snap disguises 2 win early downs with quicks screens and runs if opponents want to avoid the chaotic pressures flores likes to employ on third down they must stay on schedule by gaining 4 plus yards on first down using a mix of quick throws screens and downhill runs to keep minnesota defenders guessing considering minnesota s ridiculous blitz rate thus far this season 75 percent nearly 30 percent more than anyone else the ball has to come out quickly to keep the quarterback upright in the pocket although the vikings utilize vision and break blitz zones with defenders keying the quarterback catch and throw routes are the best way to consistently pick up 5 yard gains whether targeting running backs tight ends or wide receivers on swings quick outs hitches or slants the high percentage throws create a series of 1 on 1 tackling drills that test the defense s prowess in space moreover it gives the offense a chance to produce some chunk plays on easy throws given how challenging it is to tackle early in the season due to limited reps in preseason and training camp it makes sense to test minnesota s defensive backs on the perimeter if a few quick passes turn into big plays after missed tackles the ultra aggressive play caller might have to scale back some of his exotics to settle down his troops beyond the screens and quick game strategies opponents must run the ball at the vikings despite minnesota s heavy use of six man pressures that snuff out many running plays a persistent ground attack keeps the game plan from turning into a one dimensional call sheet more suited to a 7 on 7 passing competition the vikings rank 13th in rush defense with opponents averaging 100 yards per game on the ground although those numbers are solid for a defense that aims to harass quarterbacks and create turnovers it suggests opponents might be able to carve out some room on the ground with early down runs to stay on schedule against a d that wants to create chaos at every turn 3 take your shot flores is unapologetically aggressive following a live by the blitz die by the blitz creed that scares some offensive play callers into submission however the aggressive pressure tactics create plenty of big play opportunities if the protection holds up at the line of scrimmage with that in mind quarterbacks must attack the pressure with scripted deep balls that punish the vikings for leaving their defensive backs on islands whether using max protection out of run heavy sets on second third and short situations or taking a shot on first down opponents must consistently threaten the vikes downfield to keep their defensive backs from squatting on short and intermediate routes moreover the selective deep shots could make flores reconsider some of his choices if his unit surrenders a big play or two early in the contest remember the packers raced out to a lead against the vikings in week 1 by taking a few shots to christian watson tucker kraft and jonnu smith by flipping the script on the vikings and attacking their pressure with long bombs opponents can dictate the terms to the defense and turn minnesota s aggressive approach into a favorable situation three wildly disappointing units can they be fixed while the bills offense and vikings defense have opened the 2026 campaign in style several units have seriously stumbled out of the gates i d like to spotlight three that have been particularly awful

news_mentions.headline: Week 3 fantasy sleepers: Jets QB Geno Smith, Eagles WR Dontayvion Wicks offer upside
news_mentions.description: Will Geno Smith rack up big numbers against the Lions? Which Eagles receiver could be a sneaky-good play? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 3.
news_mentions.body_text: there s no way to sugarcoat it injuries have sucked a lot of air out of the balloon that is the young season that s not just from a fantasy perspective every football fan wants to watch caleb williams jayden daniels brock bowers and puka nacua on sundays the sport is better when those guys are playing but in fantasy we strategically picked guys like nico collins saquon barkley and dj moore to help us win our leagues now we have to hear the friend who autodrafted boast about being 2 0 not ideal this makes finding sneaky values that much more important not every addition has to be a league winner my goal right now is to get you those week winning stopgaps while your stars are on the mend with that being said welcome to the infirmary of week 3 note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Jayden Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on IR; Commanders GM says surgery 'not on the table'
news_mentions.description: Washington Commanders general manager Adam Peters took an optimistic stance on Jayden Daniels’ recovery from his latest elbow injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the commanders took an optimistic stance friday on jayden daniels recovery from his latest elbow injury as of right now surgery is not on the table and we haven t discussed injured reserve general manager adam peters said friday morning on the sports junkies on 106 7 the fan radio so it s just a matter of how we re going to get him back on the field that s still to be determined the most notable part of peters comment was that washington doesn t view ir as an option right now meaning the club expects the quarterback back sooner than a four week absence that would be required if he goes on ir coach dan quinn confirmed later friday that daniels will not be placed on ir as peters indicated the former offensive rookie of the year is considered week to week after undergoing imaging and consulting with multiple specialists about the injury to gain clarity on the extent of his absence like most things when you want to wait it out you go through the what ifs in your head and sometimes those are worse than the actual news quinn said what a great bit of news for him and for us daniels went down at the end of the first half of sunday s loss to dallas after a lineman stepped on him the qb tried to brace his fall with his non throwing arm which bent awkwardly daniels was later diagnosed with a dislocated elbow last year daniels season was also knocked off kilter and eventually ended by injuries to the same elbow peters comments don t provide a clear timeline for daniels returning to the field quinn said on monday that the expectation is marcus mariota will start sunday against seattle however with daniels not expected to land on ir there is a shot the qb returns in the next few weeks washington plays indianapolis in london in week 4 hosts the new york giants in week 5 and travels to san francisco to face the 49ers in prime time in week 6 before a bye

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys defense hopes to stay 'disciplined' vs. Lamar Jackson after struggling with mobile QBs
news_mentions.description: The Cowboys head to Brazil this week to face Lamar Jackson and the Ravens in the NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro. The revamped Dallas D understands it has its hands full attempting to slow Jackson & Co.
news_mentions.body_text: the dallas cowboys head to brazil this week to face lamar jackson and the baltimore ravens in the nfl s first ever game in rio de janeiro the revamped dallas defense understands it has its hands full attempting to slow jackson and co we all know what it is cowboys pass rusher donovan ezeiruaku said via the team s official website you guys know we know as players the type of guy he is somebody who can throw the ball but also run the ball at a very high level it s easier to say than to do but our job is to go out there and go do that s what we re tasked with jackson leads the nfl with 10 0 pass yards per attempt through two weeks the qb hasn t run a ton 11 carries for 74 yards and a touchdown but has looked more spry when he has taken off than a year ago the cowboys must key on his scrambling ability after struggling to stop qb runs in the first two weeks against jaxson dart 11 54 and jayden daniels 7 69 the cowboys have allowed the most rushing yards to quarterbacks in the nfl 126 on 19 carries 6 6 ypc that figure would have been even worse had daniels not exited last sunday s game at halftime with an elbow injury dallas must make a more concerted effort to slow jackson just being disciplined cowboys defensive tackle kenny clark said communication just understanding our rush lanes playing with extension powering offensive linemen and just restricting those gaps so you can t get through but the main thing is just staying disciplined and communicating the ravens missing zay flowers due to a hamstring injury weren t as explosive in week 2 but the combination of jackson and derrick henry will always trouble defenses despite just five carries in the second half on sunday henry has 212 rush yards and four rush tds through two games he s tied for the nfl lead in tds and only kenneth walker 290 has more rush yards slowing both jackson and henry in the same game is a monumental task for any defense it is very unique ezeiruaku said for a guy who s probably bigger than me playing running back you ve got to take out the legs that s the only way to stop a guy like that from running the ball easier said than done like it is with lamar but it ll be a really good challenge on paper it s a rough matchup for dallas defense which through two games hasn t shown significant improvement from a year ago under christian parker too many mental mistakes remain there is a lack of pass rush and the tackling is mediocre dallas enters sunday s tilt ranked 32nd in third down percent allowed 68 30th in rush yards per game allowed 173 5 29th in yards per game allowed 391 5 29th in sacks 24th in yards per play allowed 5 8 18th in points per game 24 0 and 17th in pass yards per game 218
